```typescript
import { PrismaService } from '../src/infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { sealChannelCredential } from '../src/domain/channels/channel-credential-crypto';
import { OutboundService } from '../src/domain/inbox/outbound.service';
import { Channel, type ChannelMessage, type ChannelMessageKind, type ChannelSendOptions, type ChannelSendResult, type TextMessage } from '../src/domain/channels/transport/channel';
import { ChannelAdapterFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/channel-adapter-factory';
import { ChannelAdapterRegistry } from '../src/integrations/channels/channel-adapter-registry';
import type { ResolvedChannelCredential } from '../src/domain/channels/channel-credential-resolver';
import { MetaChannelFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/meta-channel';
import { EvolutionChannelFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/evolution-channel';
import { MetaHttpClient } from '../src/integrations/meta/meta.client';
import { MetaInitialMessageClient } from '../src/integrations/meta/initial-message.client';
import {
  contratarCanalNaoOficial, criarCanalVerificado, criarMantenedora, evolutionFake, limparBanco, login, metaFake, subirApp,
} from './helpers';

class OpaqueRecipientChannel extends Channel {
  constructor(private readonly sent: TextMessage[]) { super(); }
  readonly supportedKinds: readonly ChannelMessageKind[] = Object.freeze(['text']);
  async sendMessage(message: ChannelMessage, options?: ChannelSendOptions): Promise<ChannelSendResult> {
    if (message.kind !== 'text') return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'UNSUPPORTED_KIND' };
    let claimed: boolean;
    try { claimed = await options?.beforeDispatch?.() ?? false; } catch { claimed = false; }
    if (!claimed) return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' };
    this.sent.push(message);
    return { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: `opaque-fake-${this.sent.length}` };
  }
}

class OpaqueRecipientFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'OFICIAL' as const;
  constructor(private readonly sent: TextMessage[]) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return true; }
  create() { return new OpaqueRecipientChannel(this.sent); }
}

class MutatingMetaFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'OFICIAL' as const;
  private readonly delegate = new MetaChannelFactory(metaFake, new MetaInitialMessageClient(metaFake));
  constructor(private readonly mutateBeforeFence: () => Promise<void>) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return this.delegate.locallyConfigured(); }
  create(credential: ResolvedChannelCredential, beforeDispatch: () => Promise<boolean>) {
    return this.delegate.create(credential, async () => {
      await this.mutateBeforeFence();
      return beforeDispatch();
    });
  }
}

class MutatingEvolutionFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const;
  private readonly delegate = new EvolutionChannelFactory(evolutionFake);
  constructor(private readonly mutateBeforeFence: () => Promise<void>) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return this.delegate.locallyConfigured(); }
  create(credential: ResolvedChannelCredential, beforeDispatch: () => Promise<boolean>) {
    return this.delegate.create(credential, async () => {
      await this.mutateBeforeFence();
      return beforeDispatch();
    });
  }
}

  it('blocks real binding changes inside Meta/Evolution adapter pre-dispatch callbacks', async () => {
    const cases = [
      { provider: 'OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'generation' as const },
      { provider: 'OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'pairingEpoch' as const },
      { provider: 'OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'credentialVersion' as const },
      { provider: 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'generation' as const },
      { provider: 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'pairingEpoch' as const },
    ];
    for (const { provider, changed } of cases) {
      let mutate!: () => Promise<void>;
      const previousModuleSwitch = process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL;
      if (provider === 'NAO_OFICIAL') process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL = 'true';
      const registry = new ChannelAdapterRegistry([provider === 'OFICIAL'
        ? new MutatingMetaFactory(() => mutate())
        : new MutatingEvolutionFactory(() => mutate())]);
      const isolated = await subirApp(registry);
      try {
        await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
        const tenant = await criarMantenedora(isolated.app, `Pre-dispatch ${changed}`, `pre-dispatch-${changed}@example.test`);
        if (provider === 'NAO_OFICIAL') {
          await contratarCanalNaoOficial(isolated.prisma, tenant.mantenedora.id);
        }
        const localBinding = await criarCanalVerificado(isolated.prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, provider,
          `pre-dispatch-${provider}-${changed}`, { requiresWindow: false });
        const localConversation = await isolated.prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
          buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, contact: `user:opaque-${provider}-${changed}`, contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
        } });
        await seedHistoricalInbound(isolated.prisma, localConversation.id, tenant.businessUnit.id, provider);
        const localCookie = await login(isolated.app, `pre-dispatch-${changed}@example.test`);
        let changedOnce = false;
        mutate = async () => {
          if (changedOnce) return;
          changedOnce = true;
          if (changed === 'generation') {
            await isolated.prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: localBinding.channel.id }, data: { generation: { increment: 1 } } });
          } else if (changed === 'pairingEpoch') {
            await isolated.prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: localBinding.channel.id }, data: { pairingEpoch: { increment: 1 } } });
          } else {
            await isolated.prisma.channelCredential.update({ where: { channelId: localBinding.channel.id }, data: { version: { increment: 1 } } });
          }
        };
        const metaCallsBefore = metaFake.providerCalls;
        const evolutionCallsBefore = evolutionFake.providerCalls;
        await request(isolated.app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${localConversation.id}/messages`)
          .set('Cookie', localCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: `blocked ${changed}` })
          .expect(409).expect(({ body }) => expect(body).toMatchObject({ code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'BLOCKED' }));
        expect(await isolated.prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId: localConversation.id, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(0);
        expect(metaFake.providerCalls).toBe(metaCallsBefore);
        expect(evolutionFake.providerCalls).toBe(evolutionCallsBefore);
      } finally {
        await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
        await isolated.app.close();
        if (previousModuleSwitch === undefined) delete process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL;
        else process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL = previousModuleSwitch;
      }
    }
  });

  it('persists nothing for contradictory successful Meta envelopes', async () => {
    process.env.GRAPH_VERSION = 'v26.0';
    const fetchFake = vi.fn()
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({ success: false, messages: [{ id: 'contradictory' }] }) })
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({ success: false, messages: [{}] }) });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchFake);
    const isolatedMeta = new MetaHttpClient();
    const isolated = await subirApp(new ChannelAdapterRegistry([new MetaChannelFactory(isolatedMeta, new MetaInitialMessageClient(isolatedMeta))]));
    try {
      await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
      const tenant = await criarMantenedora(isolated.app, 'Contradictory Meta ACK', 'contradictory-meta@example.test');
      await criarCanalVerificado(isolated.prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, 'OFICIAL', 'contradictory-meta-resource', { requiresWindow: false });
      const conversation = await isolated.prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
        buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, contact: 'user:opaque', contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
      } });
      await seedHistoricalInbound(isolated.prisma, conversation.id, tenant.businessUnit.id);
      const session = await login(isolated.app, 'contradictory-meta@example.test');
      for (let requestIndex = 1; requestIndex <= 2; requestIndex += 1) {
        await request(isolated.app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversation.id}/messages`)
          .set('Cookie', session).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: `contradictory result ${requestIndex}` })
          .expect(400).expect(({ body }) => expect(body).toMatchObject({
            outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED',
          }));
        expect((await request(isolated.app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversation.id}/messages`)
          .set('Cookie', session)).body.messages.filter((message: { direction: string }) => message.direction === 'OUT')).toHaveLength(0);
        expect(fetchFake).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(requestIndex);
        expect(await isolated.prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId: conversation.id, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(0);
      }
    } finally {
      vi.unstubAllGlobals();
      await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
      await isolated.app.close();
    }
  });

  it('holds two tenants in flight with distinct scoped resources and credentials', async () => {
    const tenantB = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Parallel tenant B', 'parallel-tenant-b@example.test');
    const channelA = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId, type: 'OFICIAL' } });
    const bindingA = {
      channel: channelA,
      identity: await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { currentChannelId: channelA.id } }),
    };
    const bindingB = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, tenantB.businessUnit.id, 'OFICIAL', 'parallel-resource-b', { requiresWindow: false });
    const credentialA = await prisma.channelCredential.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { channelId: bindingA.channel.id } });
    const credentialB = await prisma.channelCredential.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { channelId: bindingB.channel.id } });
    const key = Buffer.from(process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY!, 'base64');
    const tokenA = 'tenant-a-distinct-scoped-token';
    const tokenB = 'tenant-b-distinct-scoped-token';
    for (const [binding, credential, token] of [[bindingA, credentialA, tokenA], [bindingB, credentialB, tokenB]] as const) {
      const envelope = sealChannelCredential(token, credential.keyId, key, {
        purpose: 'active', provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: binding.channel.buId,
        channelId: binding.channel.id, generation: binding.channel.generation, version: credential.version,
      });
      await prisma.channelCredential.update({ where: { channelId: binding.channel.id }, data: {
        nonce: new Uint8Array(envelope.nonce), ciphertext: new Uint8Array(envelope.ciphertext), tag: new Uint8Array(envelope.tag),
      } });
      metaFake.credentialByPhone.set(binding.channel.phoneNumberId!, token);
    }
    const conversationA = await prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
      buId, contact: 'user:tenant-a', contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
    } });
    const conversationB = await prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
      buId: tenantB.businessUnit.id, contact: 'user:tenant-b', contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
    } });
    await seedHistoricalInbound(prisma, conversationA.id, buId);
    await seedHistoricalInbound(prisma, conversationB.id, tenantB.businessUnit.id);
    const cookieB = await login(app, 'parallel-tenant-b@example.test');
    let arrived = 0;
    let markBothEntered!: () => void;
    let releaseBoth!: () => void;
    const bothEntered = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { markBothEntered = resolve; });
    const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseBoth = resolve; });
    metaFake.sendHook = async () => { arrived += 1; if (arrived === 2) markBothEntered(); await held; };
    const pendingA = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversationA.id}/messages`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: 'tenant A parallel' }).then((response) => response);
    const pendingB = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversationB.id}/messages`)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: 'tenant B parallel' }).then((response) => response);
    await bothEntered;
    expect(metaFake.credentialCalls.map(({ phoneNumberId, accessToken }) => ({ phoneNumberId, accessToken })).sort((a, b) => a.phoneNumberId.localeCompare(b.phoneNumberId)))
      .toEqual([
        { phoneNumberId: channelA.phoneNumberId!, accessToken: tokenA },
        { phoneNumberId: 'parallel-resource-b', accessToken: tokenB },
      ]);
    releaseBoth();
    const [responseA, responseB] = await Promise.all([pendingA, pendingB]);
    expect(responseA.status).toBe(201);
    expect(responseB.status).toBe(201);
    const [messageA, messageB] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.message.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId: conversationA.id, direction: 'OUT' } }),
      prisma.message.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId: conversationB.id, direction: 'OUT' } }),
    ]);
    expect(messageA).toMatchObject({ buId, providerResourceIdentityId: bindingA.identity.id, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', content: 'tenant A parallel' });
    expect(messageB).toMatchObject({ buId: tenantB.businessUnit.id, providerResourceIdentityId: bindingB.identity.id, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', content: 'tenant B parallel' });
    expect(metaFake.enviados).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([
      { para: 'user:tenant-a', texto: 'tenant A parallel' },
      { para: 'user:tenant-b', texto: 'tenant B parallel' },
    ]));
  });

    const operationsPerRound = 20;

    const acceptedCounts: number[] = [];
    const recordedCounts: number[] = [];
    const perOwnedConversationRowCounts: number[][] = [];

      } })));

      metaFake.sendHook = async () => {

      let responses: Array<{ status: number }>;
      let barrierTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
      try {
        await Promise.race([barrier, new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
          barrierTimer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('overlap barrier timed out')), 20_000);
        })]);
      } finally {
        if (barrierTimer) clearTimeout(barrierTimer);

      const recorded = await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId: { in: conversations.map(({ id }) => id) }, direction: 'OUT' } });
      const groupedRows = await prisma.message.groupBy({

      });
      const rowCountByConversation = new Map(groupedRows.map((row) => [row.conversationId, row._count._all]));
      const ownedConversationRowCounts = conversations.map(({ id }) => rowCountByConversation.get(id) ?? 0);
      operationCounts.push(responses.length);
      acceptedCounts.push(accepted);
      recordedCounts.push(recorded);
      perOwnedConversationRowCounts.push(ownedConversationRowCounts);
      expect(accepted).toBe(operationsPerRound);
      expect(recorded).toBe(operationsPerRound);
      expect(ownedConversationRowCounts).toEqual(Array(operationsPerRound).fill(1));
```

```typescript
/**
 * Liga o canal não oficial nos DOIS níveis: o teto da instalação (env, lido no
 * boot do serviço) e o contrato da Mantenedora (banco) — ADR-0016.
 *
 * Precisa vir ANTES de `subirApp`, porque o teto é lido uma vez na construção.
 * É o mesmo que acontece em produção: mudar módulo de instalação é deploy.
 */
export function tetoComCanalNaoOficial(): void {
  process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL = 'true';
}

export async function contratarCanalNaoOficial(prisma: PrismaService, mantenedoraId: string): Promise<void> {
  await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.upsert({
    where: { mantenedoraId },
    create: { mantenedoraId, modulos: { canalNaoOficial: true } },
    update: { modulos: { canalNaoOficial: true } },
  });
}

export async function subirApp(registryOverride?: ChannelAdapterRegistry, captureQueries = false): Promise<{ app: INestApplication; prisma: PrismaService }> {
  process.env.SESSION_SECRET ||= 'segredo-de-teste';
  process.env.INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN = TOKEN_INTERNO;
  process.env.META_APP_ID = 'fixture-app';
  process.env.META_APP_SECRET = META_APP_SECRET;
  process.env.META_SIGNUP_CONFIG_ID = 'fixture-config';
  process.env.GRAPH_VERSION = 'v26.0';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET = EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://api.example.test/webhooks/evolution';
  process.env.WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN = 'verify-token-de-teste';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID = 'fixture-key-v1';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY = Buffer.alloc(32, 17).toString('base64');

  const testingModule = Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
    .overrideProvider(META_CLIENT)
    .useValue(metaFake)
    .overrideProvider(EVOLUTION_CLIENT)
    .useValue(evolutionFake)
    .overrideProvider(TYPEBOT_CLIENT)
    .useValue(typebotFake);
  if (captureQueries) {
    testingModule.overrideProvider(PrismaService).useValue(new PrismaService({ log: [{ emit: 'event', level: 'query' }] }));
  }
  if (registryOverride) testingModule.overrideProvider(ChannelAdapterRegistry).useValue(registryOverride);
  const moduleRef = await testingModule.compile();
  // A MESMA fiação de produção: sem isto o corpo bruto não existe e o teste de
  // assinatura passaria a provar outra coisa.
  const app = moduleRef.createNestApplication({ bodyParser: false });
  configurarBodyParsers(app as unknown as NestExpressApplication);
  await app.init();
  return { app, prisma: app.get(PrismaService) };
}

/** Cria um usuário com papel escolhido numa BU — para o caso "papel insuficiente". */
export async function criarUsuario(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  mantenedoraId: string,
  buId: string,
  email: string,
  role: 'OWNER' | 'ADMIN' | 'ATENDENTE',
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
): Promise<string> {
  const bcrypt = await import('bcryptjs');
  const user = await prisma.appUser.create({
    data: {
      mantenedoraId,
      name: email,
      email,
      passwordHash: await bcrypt.default.hash(senha, 10),
    },
  });
  await prisma.userBuRole.create({ data: { userId: user.id, buId, role, grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' } });
  return user.id;
}

/** Test channel fixture with the same durable ownership and credential invariants as production. */
export async function criarCanalVerificado(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  buId: string,
  type: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL',
  externalResourceId: string,
  options: { status?: 'CONECTADO' | 'CONECTANDO' | 'DESCONECTADO'; requiresWindow?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const channel = await prisma.buChannel.create({ data: {
    buId, type, status: options.status ?? 'CONECTADO', requiresWindow: options.requiresWindow ?? type === 'OFICIAL',
    ...(type === 'OFICIAL' ? { phoneNumberId: externalResourceId } : { evolutionInstanceName: externalResourceId }),
    ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: 0, providerConnectionState: type === 'OFICIAL' ? 'SUBSCRIBED' : 'CONNECTED',
    receiptVerifiedAt: new Date(),
  } });
  const priorIdentity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUnique({
    where: { provider_externalResourceId: { provider: type, externalResourceId } },
  });
  if (priorIdentity && (priorIdentity.buId !== buId || priorIdentity.currentChannelId)) {
    throw new Error('Fixture resource identity is owned or active elsewhere.');
  }
  const identity = priorIdentity
    ? await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.update({ where: { id: priorIdentity.id }, data: { currentChannelId: channel.id, retiredAt: null, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE' } })
    : await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.create({ data: {
      provider: type, externalResourceId, buId, currentChannelId: channel.id, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE',
    } });
  if (type === 'OFICIAL') {
    const keyId = process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID!;
    const key = Buffer.from(process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY!, 'base64');
    const envelope = sealChannelCredential('fixture-scoped-token', keyId, key, {
      purpose: 'active', provider: type, buId, channelId: channel.id, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
    });
    await prisma.channelCredential.create({ data: {
      channelId: channel.id, provider: type, buId, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
      keyId, nonce: new Uint8Array(envelope.nonce), ciphertext: new Uint8Array(envelope.ciphertext), tag: new Uint8Array(envelope.tag),
    } });
  }
  return { channel, identity };
}

/** Cria uma Mantenedora pela superfície interna — o caminho real de bootstrap. */
/**
 * Cria a Mantenedora **com o onboarding já concluído**.
 *
 * O bootstrap a cria PENDENTE (ADR-0016 §4), e é assim em produção. Os testes
 * que exercitam o produto vêm depois do wizard; quem exercita o portão é
 * `onboarding.e2e-spec.ts`, que usa `criarMantenedoraPendente`.
 */
export async function criarMantenedora(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const r = await criarMantenedoraPendente(app, nome, email, senha);
  const prisma = app.get(PrismaService);
  await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.update({
    where: { mantenedoraId: r.mantenedora.id },
    data: { onboardingConcluido: true },
  });
  return r;
}

export async function criarMantenedoraPendente(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/internal/mantenedoras')
    .set('x-internal-token', TOKEN_INTERNO)
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ nome, bu: { nome: `Número da ${nome}`, telefone: '5584999990000' }, owner: { nome: 'Dono', email, senha } })
    .expect(201);
  return res.body as {
    mantenedora: { id: string; nome: string };
    businessUnit: { id: string; nome: string };
    owner: { id: string; email: string };
  };
}

/** Faz login e devolve o cookie de sessão para reusar nas próximas chamadas. */
export async function login(app: INestApplication, email: string, senha = 'senha-de-teste-1'): Promise<string> {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/bff/auth/login')
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ email, senha })
    .expect(200);
  const setCookie = res.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
  return setCookie[0].split(';')[0];
}
```

```typescript
}

      return item ? json(res, 200, onboarding.meta.contradictoryTemplateGet ? { ...item, error: { code: 1, message: 'controlled contradictory response' } } : item)

    }

        || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(buId)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid attempt scope' });

      if (!current || !['AMBIGUOUS', 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', 'PREPARED'].includes(current.state)) return json(res, 404, { error: 'eligible fixture attempt not found' });
      const changed = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.updateMany({

          : { dispatchDeadlineAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1_000) },
      });
      if (changed.count !== 1) return json(res, 404, { error: 'eligible fixture attempt not found' });
      return json(res, 200, { expired: true, attemptId, buId });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/initial-attempt/prepare') {

      const actorId = typeof data.actorId === 'string' ? data.actorId : '';
      if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(conversationId) || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(buId) || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(actorId)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid initial reservation scope' });
      const [conversation, channel, role] = await Promise.all([

      };

      });

    }

      const result = await seedNumberOnboarding(data);

      return json(res, 200, { status: conversation.status, unreadCount: conversation.unreadCount, messages });
    }
    if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url.startsWith('/audit-outbound?')) {

      onboarding.meta.sendMode = data.mode;

      const channel = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId: conversation.buId, type: 'NAO_OFICIAL' } });
      const identity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { currentChannelId: channel.id } });
      const message = await prisma.message.create({ data: {
        conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO',
        content: 'ingress fixture selects Evolution', channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA',
        externalId: `fixture-ingress-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
        providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id, createdAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
      } });
      return json(res, 201, { id: message.id });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/incoming') return json(res, 200, await incoming(data));
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/late-tie') {
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: data.conversationId } });
      const message = await prisma.message.create({ data: {
        id: String(data.id), conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId,
        direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: 'inserção empatada tardia',
        channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA', createdAt: new Date(data.createdAt),
      } });
      return json(res, 201, { id: message.id });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/revoke') {
      await prisma.userBuRole.deleteMany({ where: { userId: data.userId, buId: data.businessUnitId } });
      return json(res, 200, { revoked: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/restore-fixture-grant') {
      const userId = typeof data.userId === 'string' ? data.userId : '';
      const buId = typeof data.businessUnitId === 'string' ? data.businessUnitId : '';
      if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(userId) || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(buId)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid fixture grant scope' });
      await prisma.userBuRole.upsert({ where: { userId_buId: { userId, buId } },
        create: { userId, buId, role: 'OWNER', grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' }, update: { role: 'OWNER', grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' } });
      return json(res, 200, { restored: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/burst') {
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: data.conversationId } });
      const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(data.count ?? 120), 500));
      const base = new Date(data.createdAt ?? Date.now());
      await prisma.message.createMany({ data: Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
        conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO',
        content: `burst ${i + 1}`, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA',
        createdAt: new Date(base.getTime() + i),
      })) });
      return json(res, 201, { count });
    }
    return json(res, 404, { error: 'not found' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return json(res, 500, { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
  }
});
server.listen(fixturePort, '127.0.0.1', () => console.log(`timeline fixtures listening on 127.0.0.1:${fixturePort}`));
process.on('SIGTERM', () => server.close(() => prisma.$disconnect().finally(() => process.exit(0))));
process.on('SIGINT', () => server.close(() => prisma.$disconnect().finally(() => process.exit(0))));
```

```typescript
      const state = await fixture('/provider/state');

        ? { outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'META_RECUSOU' }
        : { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: `timeline-wamid-${metaFake.enviados.length}` };
    },
    enviados: [],
  };
  const evolutionInventory = new Map();
  const evolutionFake = {
    configurado: () => true,
    async criarInstancia(name) {
      const channel = await fixturePrisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { evolutionInstanceName: name }, select: { id: true, buId: true, generation: true, pairingEpoch: true, currentAttemptId: true } });
      const result = await fixture('/provider/evolution/create', 'POST', { name, channelId: channel?.id, attemptId: channel?.currentAttemptId, generation: channel?.generation, pairingEpoch: channel?.pairingEpoch });
      evolutionInventory.set(name, result.instance); return { qrcode: result.instance.qrcode };
    },
    async qrDaInstancia(name) { await call('evolution.qr', { name }); const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); return observed?.qrcode ?? null; },
    async estadoDaInstancia(name) { const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); return observed?.connectionStatus ?? 'close'; },
    async consultarInstancia(name) { return fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); },
    async apagarInstancia(name) { await fixture('/provider/evolution/delete', 'POST', { name }); evolutionInventory.delete(name); },
    async enviarTexto(name, contact, text) {
      const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); if (!observed) throw new Error('unknown exact instance');
      const state = await fixture('/provider/state'); await call('evolution.send', { name });
      evolutionFake.enviados.push(text); const id = `timeline-evo-${evolutionFake.enviados.length}`;
      if (state.evolution.echoInsideSend === true) {
        const payload = { event: 'messages.upsert', instance: name, data: { key: { remoteJid: `${contact}@s.whatsapp.net`, fromMe: true, id }, pushName: 'Fixture', message: { conversation: text } } };
        const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${process.env.PORT ?? '3100'}/webhooks/evolution`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-leadshug-webhook-secret': process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('authenticated fixture webhook rejected');
      }
      return { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: id };
    },
    enviados: [],
  };
  const moduleRef = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
    .overrideProvider(META_CLIENT).useValue(metaFake)
    .overrideProvider(EVOLUTION_CLIENT).useValue(evolutionFake)
    .compile();
  fixturePrisma = moduleRef.get(PrismaService);
  const app = moduleRef.createNestApplication({ bodyParser: false });
  configurarBodyParsers(app);
  app.enableCors({ origin: ['http://127.0.0.1:4173'], credentials: true });
  await app.init();
  app.get(RealtimeService).ligar(app.getHttpServer());
  await app.listen(Number(process.env.PORT ?? '3100'), '0.0.0.0');
  const close = async () => { await app.get(PrismaService).$disconnect(); await app.close(); };
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => void close().finally(() => process.exit(0)));
  process.on('SIGINT', () => void close().finally(() => process.exit(0)));
  console.log(`timeline test API listening on ${process.env.PORT ?? '3100'}; database ${dbName}`);
}

main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { renderInitialTemplate } from './initial-message-template-renderer';
import type { TemplateSummary } from '../message-templates/template-management.ports';

function summary(parameterFormat: TemplateSummary['parameterFormat'], body: string): TemplateSummary {
  return {
    remoteTemplateId: 'remote-1', status: 'APPROVED', name: 'hello_customer', language: 'pt_BR',
    category: 'UTILITY', parameterFormat, components: [{
      type: 'BODY', text: body,
      parameters: [...body.matchAll(/\{\{([^{}]+)\}\}/g)].map((match) => match[1]),
    }],
    // These ST-05 authoring flags deliberately do not authorize or reject initial rendering.
    supported: false, semanticFingerprint: null,
  };
}

describe('initial message template renderer', () => {
  it('renders a NAMED body from sanitized catalog components despite authoring flags', () => {
    const rendered = renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', 'Oi {{first_name}}, pedido {{order_id}} chegou.'), {
      first_name: 'Ana', order_id: '42',
    });
    expect(rendered.text).toBe('Oi Ana, pedido 42 chegou.');
    expect(rendered.semanticFingerprint).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
  });

  it('renders POSITIONAL values in component occurrence order without trusting the null catalog fingerprint', () => {
    const rendered = renderInitialTemplate(summary('POSITIONAL', 'Oi {{1}}, seu pedido {{2}} está pronto, {{1}}.'), ['Ana', '42']);
    expect(rendered.text).toBe('Oi Ana, seu pedido 42 está pronto, Ana.');
    expect(rendered.semanticFingerprint).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
  });

  it('maps POSITIONAL values numerically when the first BODY occurrence is out of order and repeats a key', () => {
    const rendered = renderInitialTemplate(summary('POSITIONAL', '{{2}} then {{1}} and again {{2}}'), ['Ana', '42']);
    expect(rendered.text).toBe('42 then Ana and again 42');
  });

  it('rejects gaps, missing or extra values, and non-static header/footer placeholders', () => {
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(summary('POSITIONAL', 'Oi {{2}}'), ['Ana', '42'])).toThrow();
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', 'Oi {{first_name}}'), {})).toThrow();
    const withHeader = { ...summary('NAMED', 'Oi'), components: [
      { type: 'HEADER' as const, format: 'TEXT' as const, text: '{{name}}', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: 'Oi', parameters: [] },
    ] };
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(withHeader, {})).toThrow();
  });

  it('rejects a blank BODY even when a static header makes the snapshot nonempty', () => {
    const blankBody = { ...summary('NAMED', ''), components: [
      { type: 'HEADER' as const, format: 'TEXT' as const, text: 'Hello', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: '', parameters: [] },
    ] };
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(blankBody, {})).toThrow();
  });

  it('renders components in HEADER/BODY/FOOTER order even when sanitized catalog order differs', () => {
    const reordered = { ...summary('NAMED', 'Body'), components: [
      { type: 'FOOTER' as const, text: 'Footer', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: 'Body', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'HEADER' as const, format: 'TEXT' as const, text: 'Header', parameters: [] },
    ] };
    expect(renderInitialTemplate(reordered, {}).text).toBe('Header\nBody\nFooter');
  });

  it('enforces the rendered snapshot boundary including static header and footer', () => {
    const atLimit = { ...summary('NAMED', 'x'.repeat(4092)), components: [
      { type: 'HEADER' as const, format: 'TEXT' as const, text: 'H', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: 'x'.repeat(4092), parameters: [] },
      { type: 'FOOTER' as const, text: 'F', parameters: [] },
    ] };
    expect(renderInitialTemplate(atLimit, {}).text).toHaveLength(4096);
    const overLimit = { ...atLimit, components: [
      atLimit.components[0]!,
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: 'x'.repeat(4093), parameters: [] },
      atLimit.components[2]!,
    ] };
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(overLimit, {})).toThrow();
  });

  it('counts Unicode code points for the per-value limit', () => {
    const template = summary('NAMED', '{{value}}');
    expect(renderInitialTemplate(template, { value: '😀'.repeat(1024) }).text).toBe('😀'.repeat(1024));
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(template, { value: '😀'.repeat(1025) })).toThrow();
  });

  it('allows at most twenty distinct parameters and rejects extras', () => {
    const keys = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => `p${index + 1}`);
    const values = Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, 'v']));
    expect(renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', keys.map((key) => `{{${key}}}`).join(' ')), values).text)
      .toBe(keys.map(() => 'v').join(' '));
    const twentyOne = [...keys, 'p21'];
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', twentyOne.map((key) => `{{${key}}}`).join(' ')),
      Object.fromEntries(twentyOne.map((key) => [key, 'v'])))).toThrow();
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', '{{p1}}'), { p1: 'v', extra: 'x' })).toThrow();
  });
});
```

### api-app/src/domain/inbox/channel-window-policy.spec.ts

SHA256 `e20eaefd11256c8ca9f2156560ac23a1478f333b3932e865d1d52666cbd78692`. not in inherited dirty-file seal; current exact source supplied, not inferred as newly added.

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { isOfficialWindowOpen, qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp } from './channel-window-policy';

const now = new Date('2026-10-22T12:00:00.000Z');
const DAY_SECONDS = 24 * 60 * 60;

describe('qualified official window policy', () => {
  it('accepts only positive integer signed Meta timestamps no later than now', () => {
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp(String(Math.floor(now.getTime() / 1000)), now)).toEqual(now);
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp('0', now)).toBeNull();
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp('12.5', now)).toBeNull();
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp('not-a-time', now)).toBeNull();
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp(String(Math.floor(now.getTime() / 1000) + 1), now)).toBeNull();
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp(null, now)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('uses only the selected managed resource’s trusted Meta IN and a strict 24-hour boundary', () => {
    const selected = 'resource-current';
    const trustedAt = new Date(now.getTime() - (DAY_SECONDS - 1) * 1000);
    expect(isOfficialWindowOpen([
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected, officialInboundAt: trustedAt },
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: 'resource-old', officialInboundAt: now },
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected, officialInboundAt: now },
      { direction: 'OUT', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected, officialInboundAt: now },
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected, officialInboundAt: null, createdAt: now },
    ], selected, now)).toBe(true);

    expect(isOfficialWindowOpen([
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected,
        officialInboundAt: new Date(now.getTime() - DAY_SECONDS * 1000), createdAt: now },
    ], selected, now)).toBe(false);
    expect(isOfficialWindowOpen([], selected, now)).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { InitialMessageService } from './initial-message.service';

const attempt = {
  id: 'attempt-1', conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1',
  idempotencyKey: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', requestFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint',
  request: { canonicalRequest: { channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'text', text: 'Hello', previewFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint', recipient: '5511987654321' } },
  ownerNonce: 'stored-owner', state: 'SUCCEEDED', externalMessageId: 'provider-message-1', slotReleasedAt: new Date('2026-10-22T12:00:00Z'),
};

function makeService(replayAttempt = attempt) {
  const events: string[] = [];
  const prisma = {
    $transaction: vi.fn(async (callback: (tx: unknown) => Promise<boolean>) => { events.push('current-grant'); return callback({}); }),
    conversation: { findFirst: vi.fn(async () => { events.push('conversation-read'); return {
      id: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', contact: '5511987654321', contactType: 'PESSOA',
      status: 'QUEUED', attendantUserId: null, updatedAt: new Date('2026-10-22T12:00:00Z'),
    }; }) },
  };
  const outbound = {
    prepareInitial: vi.fn(async () => { events.push('channel-bind'); return { channel: {}, context: {
      channelId: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: 'resource-1',
      generation: 1, pairingEpoch: 1, activeCredentialVersion: 2, requiresWindow: true,
      providerAccountReference: 'account-ref',
    } }; }),
    sendInitial: vi.fn(async () => { events.push('dispatch'); return { id: 'message-1' }; }),
  };
  const admissions = {
    findInitialReplay: vi.fn(async () => { events.push('idempotency-lookup'); return { intent: replayAttempt, ownerNonce: 'new-request-owner' }; }),
    reserveInitial: vi.fn(),
  };
  const templates = { resolve: vi.fn() };
  const observations = { getCatalog: vi.fn() };
  return {
    service: new InitialMessageService(prisma as never, outbound as never, admissions as never, templates as never, observations as never),
    events, prisma, outbound, admissions, templates, observations,
  };
}

describe('InitialMessageService', () => {
  it('resolves a terminal idempotent replay before channel binding or any provider-facing dispatch', async () => {
    const { service, events, outbound, admissions, templates, observations } = makeService();
    const result = await service.submit({
      conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1', actorName: 'Ada',
      idempotencyKey: attempt.idempotencyKey,
      message: { channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'text', text: 'Hello', previewFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint' },
      validateActorInTransaction: async () => true,
    });

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ replay: true, attempt: { id: attempt.id, state: attempt.state, externalAccepted: true } });
    expect(result).not.toHaveProperty('ownerNonce');
    expect(events).toEqual(['current-grant', 'conversation-read', 'idempotency-lookup']);
    expect(outbound.prepareInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(outbound.sendInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(templates.resolve).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(observations.getCatalog).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(admissions.reserveInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns an uncertainty conflict for an ambiguous replay without provider reads or a new send', async () => {
    const ambiguous = { ...attempt, state: 'AMBIGUOUS', externalMessageId: null };
    const { service, events, outbound } = makeService(ambiguous);
    await expect(service.submit({
      conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1', actorName: 'Ada',
      idempotencyKey: attempt.idempotencyKey,
      message: { channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'text', text: 'Hello', previewFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint' },
      validateActorInTransaction: async () => true,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: attempt.id, state: 'AMBIGUOUS' } });
    expect(events).toEqual(['current-grant', 'conversation-read', 'idempotency-lookup']);
    expect(outbound.prepareInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(outbound.sendInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects a changed canonical request that reuses the same preview fingerprint before channel binding', async () => {
    const { service, events, outbound, admissions } = makeService();
    await expect(service.submit({
      conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1', actorName: 'Ada',
      idempotencyKey: attempt.idempotencyKey,
      message: { channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'text', text: 'Changed body', previewFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint' },
      validateActorInTransaction: async () => true,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED' } });
    expect(events).toEqual(['current-grant', 'conversation-read', 'idempotency-lookup']);
    expect(admissions.findInitialReplay).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(outbound.prepareInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('maps unsupported catalog components to a safe preview conflict before reservation or dispatch', async () => {
    const { service, outbound, admissions, templates, observations } = makeService();
    const context = {
      channelId: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', providerResourceIdentityId: 'resource-1', generation: 1,
      pairingEpoch: 1, activeCredentialVersion: 2, requiresWindow: true, providerAccountReference: 'account-ref',
      channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL',
    };
    templates.resolve.mockResolvedValue({ context: { ...context, accountReference: 'account-ref' } });
    observations.getCatalog.mockResolvedValue({ available: true, items: [{
      remoteTemplateId: 'unsupported', status: 'APPROVED', name: 'unsupported', language: 'en_US', category: 'UTILITY',
      parameterFormat: 'NAMED', components: [{ type: 'UNKNOWN', providerType: 'OTHER' }], supported: false, available: true, semanticFingerprint: null,
    }] });

    await expect(service.preview({ conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1', message: {
      channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'approved-template', remoteTemplateId: 'unsupported', language: 'en_US',
      catalogAfter: null, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64), values: {},
    } })).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'INITIAL_TEMPLATE_UNSUPPORTED' } });
    expect(admissions.reserveInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(outbound.sendInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { DispatchAdmissionService, isInitialRiskAcknowledgmentEligible } from './dispatch-admission.service';

const conversation = { id: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1' };

function setup() {
  const tx = {
    $queryRaw: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([{ id: conversation.id, bu_id: conversation.buId, contact: '5511987654321', now: new Date('2026-10-22T12:00:00Z') }]),
    conversation: { findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(conversation) },
    message: { findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null) },
    dispatchAdmission: {
      findMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
      findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: 'admission-1', conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, ownerNonce: 'owner-a', state: 'SENDING', releasedAt: null }),
      create: vi.fn(async ({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) => ({ id: 'admission-1', ...data })),
      updateMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 }),
    },
    initialMessageIntent: {
      findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null),
      findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null),
      create: vi.fn(async ({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) => ({ id: 'intent-1', ...data })),
      updateMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 }),
    },
  };
  const prisma = {
    $transaction: vi.fn((callback: (client: typeof tx) => unknown) => callback(tx)),
    dispatchAdmission: tx.dispatchAdmission,
    initialMessageIntent: tx.initialMessageIntent,
  };
  return { service: new DispatchAdmissionService(prisma as never), prisma, tx };
}

describe('DispatchAdmissionService owner-token interlock', () => {
  it('uses an inclusive immutable risk deadline only for the two acknowledgeable states', () => {
    const deadline = new Date('2026-10-22T12:00:00.000Z');
    const before = new Date(deadline.getTime() - 1);
    const exact = new Date(deadline.getTime());
    const after = new Date(deadline.getTime() + 1);
    for (const state of ['AMBIGUOUS', 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED'] as const) {
      expect(isInitialRiskAcknowledgmentEligible(state, deadline, before)).toBe(false);
      expect(isInitialRiskAcknowledgmentEligible(state, deadline, exact)).toBe(true);
      expect(isInitialRiskAcknowledgmentEligible(state, deadline, after)).toBe(true);
    }
    for (const state of ['PREPARED', 'SENDING'] as const) {
      expect(isInitialRiskAcknowledgmentEligible(state, deadline, after)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it('stores distinct ordinary owner tokens with their scoped caller and selected context', async () => {
    const { service, tx } = setup();
    const first = await service.reserveOrdinary({ conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, ownerNonce: 'owner-a', caller: 'BFF', actorId: 'user-a', selectedContext: { channelId: 'channel-1', generation: 2 } });
    const second = await service.reserveOrdinary({ conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, ownerNonce: 'owner-b', caller: 'PUBLIC', actorId: 'api-key-a', selectedContext: { channelId: 'channel-1', generation: 2 } });

    expect(first.admission).toMatchObject({ state: 'PREPARED', ownerNonce: 'owner-a' });
    expect(second.admission).toMatchObject({ state: 'PREPARED', ownerNonce: 'owner-b' });
    expect(first.ownerNonce).toBe('owner-a');
    expect(second.ownerNonce).not.toBe(first.ownerNonce);
    expect(tx.dispatchAdmission.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(tx.dispatchAdmission.create).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, expect.objectContaining({
      data: expect.objectContaining({ conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, ownerNonce: 'owner-a', caller: 'BFF', actorId: 'user-a', selectedContext: { channelId: 'channel-1', generation: 2 } }),
    }));
  });

  it('refuses an initial reservation while any ordinary token remains unreleased', async () => {
    const { service, tx } = setup();
    tx.dispatchAdmission.findMany.mockResolvedValue([{ id: 'ordinary-1', state: 'UNCERTAIN', releasedAt: null }]);

    await expect(service.reserveInitial({ conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, contact: '5511987654321', ownerNonce: 'initial-owner', actorId: 'user-a', idempotencyKey: 'key-1', selectedContext: { channelId: 'channel-1', generation: 2, providerResourceIdentityId: 'resource-1', providerAccountReference: 'account-1' }, requestFingerprint: 'fingerprint-1', request: { kind: 'text', text: 'hello' } }))
      .rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'ORDINARY_SEND_IN_PROGRESS' } });
    expect(tx.initialMessageIntent.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('refuses a new ordinary token while an initial slot remains active', async () => {
    const { service, tx } = setup();
    tx.initialMessageIntent.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'intent-active', state: 'SENDING', slotReleasedAt: null });

    await expect(service.reserveOrdinary({ conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, ownerNonce: 'ordinary-owner', caller: 'BOT', actorId: 'bot-1', selectedContext: { channelId: 'channel-1', generation: 2 } }))
      .rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'INITIAL_SEND_IN_PROGRESS', outcome: 'BLOCKED', attemptId: 'intent-active', state: 'SENDING' } });
    expect(tx.dispatchAdmission.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('does not adopt the stored owner nonce on an idempotent initial replay', async () => {
    const { service, tx } = setup();
    const selectedContext = {
      channelId: 'channel-1', buId: conversation.buId, channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL',
      providerResourceIdentityId: 'resource-1', generation: 2, pairingEpoch: 1,
      activeCredentialVersion: null, requiresWindow: false, providerAccountReference: null,
    };
    const request = { canonicalRequest: { kind: 'text', text: 'hello' } };
    tx.initialMessageIntent.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
      id: 'intent-1', conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, actorId: 'user-a',
      idempotencyKey: 'key-1', requestFingerprint: 'fingerprint-1', ownerNonce: 'original-owner',
      selectedContext, request,
    });
    const replay = await service.reserveInitial({
      conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, contact: '5511987654321', actorId: 'user-a', idempotencyKey: 'key-1',
      ownerNonce: 'new-request-owner', selectedContext,
      requestFingerprint: 'fingerprint-1', request,
    });

    expect(replay).toMatchObject({ created: false, ownerNonce: 'new-request-owner', intent: { ownerNonce: 'original-owner' } });
    expect(tx.initialMessageIntent.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('settles or releases only the matching owner token and never expires SENDING by time', async () => {
    const { service, tx } = setup();
    tx.dispatchAdmission.updateMany.mockResolvedValueOnce({ count: 1 }).mockResolvedValueOnce({ count: 0 });

    const settled = await service.settleOrdinary({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'owner-a', state: 'SETTLED' });
    const lateRelease = await service.releasePrepared({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'owner-b' });

    expect(settled).toBe(true);
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { ChannelOperationContext, ChannelSendResult } from '../channels/transport/channel';
import { OutboundService } from './outbound.service';

const context: ChannelOperationContext = Object.freeze({
  channelId: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: 'identity-1',
  generation: 1, pairingEpoch: 2, activeCredentialVersion: 3, requiresWindow: false, providerAccountReference: null,
});
const conversation = { id: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', contact: 'user:opaque', contactType: 'PESSOA' as const };

function setup(result: ChannelSendResult) {
  const channel = { sendMessage: vi.fn(async (
    _message: unknown,
    options?: { beforeDispatch?: () => Promise<boolean> },
  ) => {
    if (result.outcome === 'BLOCKED') return result;
    if (options?.beforeDispatch && !await options.beforeDispatch()) {
      return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' } as const;
    }
    return result;
  }) };
  const resolver = {
    resolveForConversation: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ channel, context }),
    resolveForInitial: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ channel, context }),
    validateOperationContextInTransaction: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    contextAfterDispatch: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('CURRENT'),
  };
  const acceptance = {
    recordAmbiguousOutbound: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: 'diagnostic-1' }),
    accept: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      message: { id: 'message-1', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL' }, creationWinner: false,
    }),
  };
  const prisma = {
    conversation: { findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(conversation) },
    message: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null) },
    $transaction: vi.fn(),
  };
  const realtime = { publicarNaBu: vi.fn() };
  const windows = { inspect: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ open: true, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000) }) };
  const admissions = {
    reserveOrdinary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ admission: { id: 'admission-1' }, ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce' }),
    claimOrdinary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    settleOrdinary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    releasePrepared: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    claimInitial: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    rejectInitial: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    rejectPreparedInitial: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    markInitialAmbiguous: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    markInitialLocalBlocked: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
  };
  const service = Reflect.construct(OutboundService, [prisma, resolver, acceptance, realtime, windows, admissions]) as OutboundService;
  return { service, resolver, acceptance, prisma, channel, windows, admissions };
}

function input() {
  return { conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, text: 'hello', attribution: { kind: 'BFF' as const, userId: 'user-1', name: 'Agent' } };

    expect(resolver.contextAfterDispatch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('gives a detected context retirement during diagnostic persistence precedence with no external-id write', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance } = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'SEND_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE' });
    acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound.mockImplementation(async () => {
      resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValue('CHANGED');
      throw new Error('identity fence rejected diagnostic transaction');
    });
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reports a confirmed diagnostic write as RECORDED if the identity retires immediately afterward', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance } = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'SEND_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE' });
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValueOnce('CURRENT').mockResolvedValueOnce('CHANGED');
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', diagnosticPersistence: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('does not start Message acceptance when the identity changed after an acknowledged send', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance, prisma } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValue('CHANGED');
    prisma.message.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reports uncertainty before local Message acceptance as UNCONFIRMED', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance, prisma } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    acceptance.accept.mockRejectedValue(new Error('fixture transaction did not confirm'));
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValue('CURRENT');
    prisma.message.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503, response: { code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
  });

  it('reports a confirmed Message commit as RECORDED after a later local finalization failure', async () => {
    const { service, acceptance, prisma } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    prisma.$transaction.mockRejectedValue(new Error('fixture conversation finalization failure'));
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503, response: { code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.accept).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('does not report complete ordinary success when the durable settlement is explicitly unconfirmed', async () => {
    const { service, acceptance, admissions, channel } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    admissions.settleOrdinary.mockResolvedValue(false);
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503, response: { code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(channel.sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(acceptance.accept).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(admissions.settleOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce', state: 'SETTLED' });
  });

  it('keeps a known committed Message RECORDED and returns context-changed after a local finalization failure', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance, prisma } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    prisma.$transaction.mockRejectedValue(new Error('fixture finalization failure'));
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValueOnce('CURRENT').mockResolvedValueOnce('CHANGED');
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.accept).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

```typescript
function initialCoordinatorBoundaryViolations(source: string): string[] {
  const rules: Array<[string, RegExp]> = [
    ['concrete provider or adapter import', /from\s+['"][^'"]*integrations\/(?:meta|evolution|channels)\/[^'"]+['"]/],
    ['provider credential resolver import', /from\s+['"][^'"]*channel-credential-resolver['"]/],
    ['direct HTTP client usage', /\bfetch\s*\(|\baxios(?:\s*\(|\.(?:get|post|put|delete|request)\s*\()/],
    ['provider client type or token', /\b(?:MetaHttpClient|MetaClient|EvolutionClient|EVOLUTION_CLIENT|META_CLIENT)\b/],
  ];
  return rules.filter(([, expression]) => expression.test(source)).map(([name]) => name);
}

      [200, { success: false, messages: [{ id: 'contradictory-id' }] }, { outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED', legacyCode: 'META_RECUSOU' }],
      [400, { error: { message: 'refused', code: 100, is_transient: false } }, { outcome: 'REJECTED', code: 'META_RECUSOU' }],

      const fetchFake = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
        const url = String(input);
        if ((init?.method ?? 'GET') === 'GET' && url.includes('/debug_token?')) return new Response(JSON.stringify(providerGrant()), { status: 200 });
        if ((init?.method ?? 'GET') === 'GET' && url.includes('/phone_numbers')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ data: [{ id: 'phone-number-id' }] }), { status: 200 });
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { MetaClient } from './meta.client';
import { metaAccountReference } from '../channels/account-reference';
import { MetaInitialMessageClient } from './initial-message.client';

describe('MetaInitialMessageClient positional template wire', () => {
  it('orders unique positional values numerically, independent of placeholder order and repetition', () => {
    const client = new MetaInitialMessageClient({} as never);
    const summary = {
      remoteTemplateId: 'tpl-1', name: 'ordered', language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY',
      parameterFormat: 'POSITIONAL', status: 'APPROVED', supported: true,
      components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: '{{2}} antes {{1}} e {{2}}', parameters: ['2', '1', '2'] }],
    } as never;
    const render = Reflect.get(client, 'templateWire') as (summary: unknown, values: readonly string[]) => unknown;
    expect(render.call(client, summary, ['primeiro', 'segundo'])).toEqual({
      name: 'ordered', language: { code: 'pt_BR' },
      components: [{ type: 'body', parameters: [{ type: 'text', text: 'primeiro' }, { type: 'text', text: 'segundo' }] }],
    });
  });

  it('does not claim or POST when bounded membership verification exhausts the total 75-second budget', async () => {
    const start = Date.now();
    let now = start;
    vi.spyOn(Date, 'now').mockImplementation(() => now);
    vi.stubEnv('GRAPH_VERSION', 'v26.0');
    const verify = vi.fn(async () => {
      now = start + 75_000;
      return { id: 'phone-fixture', telefone: '+5511999999999', nomeVerificado: 'Fixture' };
    });
    const beforeDispatch = vi.fn(async () => true);
    const fetch = vi.fn();
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetch);
    try {
      const client = new MetaInitialMessageClient({ verificarNumeroVinculado: verify } as unknown as MetaClient);
      const result = await client.sendInitialMessage({
        wabaId: 'account-fixture', phoneNumberId: 'phone-fixture', recipientE164: '+5511999999999',
        accessToken: 'scoped-fixture-token', accountReference: metaAccountReference('account-fixture'),
        payload: { kind: 'text', recipientRef: 'contact-fixture', text: 'bounded request' }, beforeDispatch,
      });
      expect(result).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_NOT_READY' });
      expect(verify).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(beforeDispatch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(fetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally {
      vi.restoreAllMocks();
      vi.unstubAllGlobals();
      vi.unstubAllEnvs();
    }
  });
});

describe('MetaInitialMessageClient acknowledgement classification', () => {

    ['malformed receipt id', 200, { messages: [{ id: 17 }] }],
    ['contradictory receipt and refusal', 400, { success: false, error: { code: 100, message: 'refused' }, messages: [{ id: 'wamid-contradiction' }] }],
    ['transient refusal', 400, { error: { code: 100, message: 'try later', is_transient: true } }],
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { TemplateSummary } from '../api';
import { fingerprintInitialTemplate, isInitialSendSnapshot } from './NovaConversa';

function summary(overrides: Partial<TemplateSummary> = {}): TemplateSummary {
  return {
    remoteTemplateId: 'remote-1', status: 'APPROVED', name: 'hello_customer', language: 'pt_BR',
    category: 'UTILITY', parameterFormat: 'POSITIONAL',
    components: [
      { type: 'BODY', text: 'Olá {{2}}, seu pedido {{1}} chegou.', parameters: ['2', '1'] },
      { type: 'FOOTER', text: 'Equipe', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'HEADER', format: 'TEXT', text: 'Atualização', parameters: [] },
    ],
    supported: false, semanticFingerprint: null, available: true, observedAt: '2026-10-22T10:00:00.000Z',
    observedFence: 'fence-1', eligible: false, ...overrides,
  };
}

function canonical(value: unknown): string {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? `[${value.map(canonical).join(',')}]`
    : value && typeof value === 'object' ? `{${Object.keys(value as Record<string, unknown>).sort()
      .map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical((value as Record<string, unknown>)[key])}`).join(',')}}`
      : JSON.stringify(value) ?? 'null';
}

function snapshotFor(message: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const body = { channelId: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', expectedGeneration: 1,
    mensagem: message, previewFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64) };
  return { key: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222', request: canonical(body), body };
}

describe('fingerprint de modelo para mensagem inicial', () => {
  it('usa a ordem semântica HEADER/BODY/FOOTER e ignora sinalizadores de autoria ST05', async () => {
    const first = summary();
    const second = summary({
      components: [first.components[2], first.components[0], { type: 'BUTTONS', buttons: [{ text: 'Gerenciar' }] }, first.components[1]],
      supported: true, semanticFingerprint: 'authoring-only', available: false, eligible: true,
      observedAt: '2026-10-22T10:05:00.000Z', observedFence: 'new-fence',
    });
    await expect(fingerprintInitialTemplate(first)).resolves.toBe(await fingerprintInitialTemplate(second));
  });

  it('mantém o formato do parâmetro e o conteúdo estático no hash semântico', async () => {
    const base = summary();
    const named = summary({ parameterFormat: 'NAMED' });
    const changedFooter = summary({ components: [base.components[0], { type: 'FOOTER', text: 'Outro rodapé', parameters: [] }, base.components[2]] });
    const fingerprint = await fingerprintInitialTemplate(base);
    await expect(fingerprintInitialTemplate(named)).resolves.not.toBe(fingerprint);
    await expect(fingerprintInitialTemplate(changedFooter)).resolves.not.toBe(fingerprint);
  });
});

describe('restauração segura da tentativa inicial', () => {
  it('applies text and template value limits in Unicode code points, independently of the bounded JSON envelope', () => {
    const textAtLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: '😀'.repeat(4096) });
    const textOverLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: '😀'.repeat(4097) });
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(textAtLimit)).toBe(true);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(textOverLimit)).toBe(false);

    const valueAtLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: ['😀'.repeat(1024)] });
    const valueOverLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: ['😀'.repeat(1025)] });
    const namedAtLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: { customer: '😀'.repeat(1024) } });
    const namedOverLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: { customer: '😀'.repeat(1025) } });
    expect(valueAtLimit.request.length).toBeLessThan(32_768);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(valueAtLimit)).toBe(true);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(valueOverLimit)).toBe(false);
    expect(namedAtLimit.request.length).toBeLessThan(32_768);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(namedAtLimit)).toBe(true);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(namedOverLimit)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('preserva o limite completo de texto aceito mesmo quando caracteres JSON são escapados', () => {
    const body = { channelId: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', expectedGeneration: 1,
      mensagem: { texto: '\u0001'.repeat(4096), tipo: 'TEXTO' }, previewFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64) };
    const canonical = (value: unknown): string => Array.isArray(value) ? `[${value.map(canonical).join(',')}]`
      : value && typeof value === 'object' ? `{${Object.keys(value as Record<string, unknown>).sort()
        .map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical((value as Record<string, unknown>)[key])}`).join(',')}}`
        : JSON.stringify(value) ?? 'null';
    const request = canonical(body);
    expect(request.length).toBeGreaterThan(16_384);
    const snapshot = { key: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222', request, body };
    const restored = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snapshot)) as unknown;
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(restored)).toBe(true);
    expect(restored).toEqual(snapshot);
  });

  it('preserva o limite de renderização do modelo após escaping JSON', () => {
    const body = { channelId: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', expectedGeneration: 1,
      mensagem: { tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
        expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => '\u0001'.repeat(1024)) },
      previewFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64) };
    const canonical = (value: unknown): string => Array.isArray(value) ? `[${value.map(canonical).join(',')}]`
      : value && typeof value === 'object' ? `{${Object.keys(value as Record<string, unknown>).sort()
        .map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical((value as Record<string, unknown>)[key])}`).join(',')}}`
        : JSON.stringify(value) ?? 'null';
    const request = canonical(body);
    expect(request.length).toBeGreaterThan(24_000);
    const snapshot = { key: '33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333', request, body };
    const restored = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snapshot)) as unknown;
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(restored)).toBe(true);
    expect(restored).toEqual(snapshot);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { ErroDaApi, api } from './api';

function responde(corpo: string, init: { status?: number; ok?: boolean } = {}) {
  const status = init.status ?? 200;
  vi.stubGlobal(
    'fetch',
    vi.fn(async () => ({
      status,
      ok: init.ok ?? status < 400,
      text: async () => corpo,
    })),
  );
}

afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

describe('resposta que não é JSON (api.ts)', () => {
  it('falha DIZENDO a causa provável, em vez de devolver objeto vazio', async () => {
    // O que o nginx do próprio front devolve quando a base da API está vazia.
    responde('<!doctype html><html><body><div id="root"></div></body></html>');

    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/base da API está VAZIA/);
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toMatchObject({ codigo: 'RESPOSTA_NAO_E_JSON' });
  });

  it('a mensagem aponta para LEADSHUG_API_URL quando a base está vazia', async () => {
    responde('<html></html>');
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/LEADSHUG_API_URL/);
  });

  it('corpo vazio com 200 continua sendo objeto vazio — isso é legítimo', async () => {
    responde('');
    await expect(api.get('/x')).resolves.toEqual({});
  });

  /**
   * Com a base CONFIGURADA — o cenário do stage.
   *
   * `API_BASE` é lida na importação do módulo, então o `window` precisa existir
   * ANTES dela. Importar de novo com `resetModules` é o que faz este teste
   * exercitar o caminho de verdade, e não o de base vazia.
   */
  async function comBase(url: string) {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: url } });
    return (await import('./api')) as typeof import('./api');
  }

  it('405 é reconhecido como servidor de ARQUIVOS, não como "API confusa"', async () => {
    // nginx responde 405 a um POST para arquivo estático. É assinatura, não
    // ambiguidade — e dizer isso poupa uma rodada de investigação.
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('<html>405</html>', { status: 405 });

    await expect(mod.api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/servidor de ARQUIVOS/);
    await expect(mod.api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/LEADSHUG_API_URL/);
  });

  it('HTML com 200 também é reconhecido como servidor de arquivos', async () => {
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('<!doctype html><html></html>');
    await expect(mod.api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/servidor de ARQUIVOS/);
  });

  it('resposta não-JSON que NÃO parece estática cai na mensagem genérica', async () => {
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('isto não é json nem html', { status: 502 });
    await expect(mod.api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/não é JSON/);
  });

  it('JSON válido passa como sempre', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ atendimento: { emEspera: 3 } }));
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).resolves.toEqual({ atendimento: { emEspera: 3 } });
  });
});

describe('base sem esquema (o erro de stage)', () => {
  it('recusa host solto: sem esquema, o navegador trata como CAMINHO', async () => {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: 'leadshug-api-stage.up.railway.app' } });
    // A chamada viraria https://<o-proprio-front>/leadshug-api-stage.../api/bff/...
    // e bateria no nginx do front — 405 no login, sem nada citando a variável.
    await expect(import('./api')).rejects.toThrow(/sem esquema/);
  });

  it('aceita https e http', async () => {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: 'https://api.exemplo.com.br' } });
    await expect(import('./api')).resolves.toBeDefined();
  });
});

describe('falha do servidor (o 500 do Nest)', () => {
  it('usa `message` quando não há `error`, e SEMPRE mostra o status', async () => {
    // Formato do 500 do Nest. Antes, isto virava "Falha inesperada." — que não
    // dizia nem que era 500.
    responde(JSON.stringify({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal server error' }), { status: 500 });
    await expect(api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow('Internal server error (HTTP 500)');
  });

  it('sem `error` e sem `message`, diz o status mesmo assim', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ statusCode: 502 }), { status: 502 });
    await expect(api.get('/x')).rejects.toThrow(/respondeu 502 sem explicar/);
  });

  it('recusa do produto continua mostrando a mensagem do produto', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ error: 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.', code: 'CREDENCIAL_INVALIDA' }), { status: 401 });
    await expect(api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/E-mail ou senha inválidos/);
  });

  it('retém outcome e metadados seguros de incerteza', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      error: 'O envio não foi confirmado.', code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID',
      localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
    }), { status: 503 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/messages', { texto: 'draft' })).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
    });
  });
});

describe('incerteza local segura em operação de modelo', () => {
  it('preserva operationId e certeza de ACK sem copiar metadados arbitrários', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      code: 'TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      operationId: 'f01ba7da-8869-4f97-a7d4-c68cc057d765',
      phase: 'ACCEPTED', outcome: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED',
      acceptanceProvenance: 'ACKNOWLEDGED', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED',
      recoveryAction: 'READ_OPERATION', token: 'must-not-be-projected',

    await expect(api.post('/message-templates/draft/submit', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({

      operationId: 'f01ba7da-8869-4f97-a7d4-c68cc057d765',
      phase: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED',
      acceptanceProvenance: 'ACKNOWLEDGED', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED',
    });
  });
});

describe('metadados permitidos para recuperação do primeiro envio', () => {
  it('preserva tentativa, estado e prazo sem copiar metadados não permitidos', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      code: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: '31a2a504-7c8f-4b8e-9fc7-c3f1c2c2d112',
      state: 'AMBIGUOUS', eligibleAt: '2026-10-22T14:00:00.000Z', credential: 'must-not-be-copied',
    }), { status: 409 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: '31a2a504-7c8f-4b8e-9fc7-c3f1c2c2d112',
      state: 'AMBIGUOUS', eligibleAt: '2026-10-22T14:00:00.000Z',
    });
  });

  it('preserva apenas o sinal booleano de recusa comprovada antes da reserva', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ code: 'PREVIEW_CONTEXT_CHANGED', preAdmission: true, ownerNonce: 'never-project' }), { status: 409 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'PREVIEW_CONTEXT_CHANGED', preAdmission: true,
    });
    responde(JSON.stringify({ code: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', preAdmission: 'true' }), { status: 409 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', preAdmission: undefined,
    });
  });

  it('descarta IDs, estados e prazos fora da allowlist/tipo', async () => {
```
