```typescript
import { expect, test, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

const FIXTURES = 'http://127.0.0.1:3101';
const FIXTURE_TOKEN = 'timeline-provider-port-only';

async function seed(request: APIRequestContext, data: Record<string, unknown> = { count: 0 }) {
  const response = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/seed`, { data });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201);
  return response.json() as Promise<{ email: string; password: string; userId: string; businessUnitId: string; otherBusinessUnitId: string; phoneNumberId: string; conversationId: string; otherConversationId: string }>;
}

function initialSendCount(records: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }>, phoneNumberId: string) {
  return records.filter((record) => record.operation === 'meta.initial.send' && record.phoneNumberId === phoneNumberId).length;
}

function resourceCallCount(records: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }>, phoneNumberId: string) {
  return records.filter((record) => record.phoneNumberId === phoneNumberId).length;
}

function watchSafeBffEndpoint(page: Page, pathname: string) {
  const events: Array<{ kind: 'response' | 'request-failed'; status?: number; code?: string; state?: string; preAdmission?: boolean; failure?: string }> = [];
  const pending: Promise<void>[] = [];
  page.on('response', (response) => {
    if (new URL(response.url()).pathname !== pathname) return;
    const event: (typeof events)[number] = { kind: 'response', status: response.status() };
    events.push(event);
    pending.push(response.json().then((body: unknown) => {
      if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) return;
      const safe = body as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (typeof safe.code === 'string') event.code = safe.code.slice(0, 80);
      if (typeof safe.state === 'string') event.state = safe.state.slice(0, 80);
      if (typeof safe.preAdmission === 'boolean') event.preAdmission = safe.preAdmission;
    }).catch(() => undefined));
  });
  page.on('requestfailed', (request) => {
    if (new URL(request.url()).pathname === pathname) events.push({ kind: 'request-failed', failure: request.failure()?.errorText?.slice(0, 160) });
  });
  return async () => { await Promise.all(pending); return events; };
}

async function waitForOpenResponse(page: Page, buId: string, diagnostics: () => Promise<unknown>) {
  const pathname = `/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/conversations/open`;
  try {
    return await page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === pathname, { timeout: 15_000 });
  } catch {
    const context = await page.evaluate((expectedBu) => {
      const bu = document.querySelector<HTMLSelectElement>('select[aria-label="Business Unit"]');
      const dialog = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="dialog"]');
      const submit = dialog ? Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button')).find((button) => button.type === 'submit') : undefined;
      return {
        selectedBu: bu?.value ?? null,
        expectedBu,
        modalVisible: Boolean(dialog && dialog.getClientRects().length),
        submitButtonLabel: submit?.textContent?.trim().slice(0, 40) ?? null,
        submitDisabled: submit?.disabled ?? null,
      };
    }, buId);
    throw new Error(`Conversation open returned no response: ${JSON.stringify({ events: await diagnostics(), context })}`);
  }
}

async function signIn(page: Page, fixture: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof seed>>) {
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.getByLabel('E-mail').fill(fixture.email);
  await page.getByLabel('Senha').fill(fixture.password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Entrar' }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/inbox$/);
  await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.businessUnitId);
}

test.describe('Nova conversa pelo BFF com PostgreSQL real', () => {
  test('ignora resposta de abertura atrasada depois da troca de Business Unit e mantém o diálogo utilizável', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request, { count: 0 });
    await signIn(page, fixture);
    const otherBuId = fixture.otherBusinessUnitId;

    const originalPath = `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`;
    let releaseResponse!: () => void;
    let signalResponse!: () => void;
    const responseGate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseResponse = resolve; });
    const responseHeld = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { signalResponse = resolve; });
    let held = false;
    await page.route('**/api/bff/business-units/*/conversations/open', async (route) => {
      if (held || new URL(route.request().url()).pathname !== originalPath) return route.continue();
      held = true;
      const response = await route.fetch();
      signalResponse();
      await responseGate;
      await route.fulfill({ response });
    });

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();
    await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill('+1 (415) 555-0191');
    const oldResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === originalPath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
    try {
      await responseHeld;
      await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(otherBuId!);
    } finally {
      releaseResponse();
    }
    expect((await oldResponse).status()).toBe(201);
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Business Unit')).toHaveValue(otherBuId!);
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito')).toBeEnabled();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Fechar' })).toBeEnabled();
    await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill('+1 (415) 555-0192');
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' })).toBeEnabled();
    await page.unroute('**/api/bff/business-units/*/conversations/open');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Fechar' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(held).toBe(true);
  });

  test('abre contato vazio sem enviar e apresenta o fluxo explícito de primeira mensagem', async ({ page, request }) => {

    let initialPosts = 0;

      if (browserRequest.method() === 'POST' && /\/api\/bff\/conversations\/[^/]+\/initial-messages$/.test(new URL(browserRequest.url()).pathname)) {

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();

    const sentAudit = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(result.conversaId)}`).then((response) => response.json()) as {
      messages: Array<{ direction: string; content: string; externalId: string | null }>; status: string;
    };
    expect(sentAudit.messages).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(sentAudit.messages[0]).toMatchObject({ direction: 'OUT', content: initialText });
    expect(sentAudit.messages[0]?.externalId).toMatch(/^timeline-initial-/);
    const providerAfter = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string }>; effects: Array<{ operation: string }> };
    expect(initialSendCount(providerAfter.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId) - initialSendCount(providerBefore.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
    expect(initialSendCount(providerAfter.effects, fixture.phoneNumberId) - initialSendCount(providerBefore.effects, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
    expect(providerAfter.calls.filter((call) => call.operation === 'meta.confirm').length
      - providerBefore.calls.filter((call) => call.operation === 'meta.confirm').length).toBe(1);
    expect(providerAfter.calls.length - providerBefore.calls.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
  });

    page.on('request', (browserRequest) => {
      if (browserRequest.method() === 'POST' && new URL(browserRequest.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`) {
        firstKey ??= browserRequest.headers()['idempotency-key'] ?? null;
        firstBody ??= browserRequest.postDataJSON();
      }
    });

    let releaseResponse: (() => void) | null = null;
    let notifyResponseReady: (() => void) | null = null;
    const responseReady = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { notifyResponseReady = resolve; });
    const holdResponse = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseResponse = resolve; });
    let responseFinished!: () => void;
    const responseDrained = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { responseFinished = resolve; });
    let responseReached = false;
    let firstRequestKey: string | null = null;
    let firstRequestBody: unknown;
    let postCount = 0;
    page.on('request', (browserRequest) => {
      if (browserRequest.method() === 'POST' && new URL(browserRequest.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`) postCount += 1;
    });
    await page.route(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`, async (route) => {
      firstRequestKey = route.request().headers()['idempotency-key'] ?? null;
      firstRequestBody = route.request().postDataJSON();
      const response = await route.fetch();
      responseReached = true;
      notifyResponseReady?.();
      try {
        await holdResponse;
        await route.fulfill({ response });
      } catch { /* Reload intentionally discards this response. */ }
      finally { responseFinished(); }
    });
    try {
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar primeiro envio' }).click();
      await responseReady;
      expect(firstRequestKey).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);
      expect(postCount).toBe(1);

      await page.addInitScript(() => {
        (window as Window & { __st04StorageReadBlocked?: boolean }).__st04StorageReadBlocked = true;
        const original = Storage.prototype.getItem;
        Storage.prototype.getItem = function (key: string) {
          const targetPrefix = 'leadshug:initial-send:v1:';
          const state = window as Window & { __st04StorageReadBlocked?: boolean };
          if (key.startsWith(targetPrefix) && state.__st04StorageReadBlocked) {
            throw new DOMException('synthetic storage read failure', 'SecurityError');
          }
          return original.call(this, key);
        };
      });
      await page.reload();
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/inbox$/);
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' })).toBeVisible();
      await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.businessUnitId);
      const stored = await page.evaluate(() => Object.entries(sessionStorage)
        .find(([key]) => key.startsWith('leadshug:initial-send:v1:'))?.[1] ?? null);
      expect(stored).toBeTruthy();
      expect(JSON.parse(stored!).key).toBe(firstRequestKey);
      expect(JSON.parse(stored!).body).toEqual(firstRequestBody);
      expect(postCount).toBe(1);
      releaseResponse?.();
      await page.unroute(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`);

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();
      await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill(phone);
    const openDiagnostics = watchSafeBffEndpoint(page, `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`);
    const reusedResponse = waitForOpenResponse(page, fixture.businessUnitId, openDiagnostics);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
      expect((await reusedResponse).status()).toBe(200);
      await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Primeira mensagem' })).toBeVisible();
      expect(postCount).toBe(1);
      expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as Window & { __st04StorageReadBlocked?: boolean }).__st04StorageReadBlocked)).toBe(true);
      const afterReadFailure = await page.evaluate(() => Object.entries(sessionStorage)
        .find(([key]) => key.startsWith('leadshug:initial-send:v1:'))?.[1] ?? null);
      expect(afterReadFailure).toBeTruthy();
      expect(JSON.parse(afterReadFailure!).key).toBe(firstKey);
      expect(JSON.parse(afterReadFailure!).body).toEqual(firstBody);
      await expect(page.getByRole('alert').filter({ hasText: 'Não foi possível verificar a tentativa salva neste navegador.' })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial')).toBeDisabled();
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar primeiro envio' })).toBeDisabled();
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recuperar tentativa salva' }).click();
      expect(postCount).toBe(1);
      await page.evaluate(() => { (window as Window & { __st04StorageReadBlocked?: boolean }).__st04StorageReadBlocked = false; });
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recuperar tentativa salva' }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retomar tentativa original' })).toBeVisible();
      const replay = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
        && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retomar tentativa original' }).click();
      const replayResponse = await replay;
      expect(replayResponse.status()).toBe(200);
      expect(replayResponse.request().headers()['idempotency-key']).toBe(firstKey);
      expect(replayResponse.request().postDataJSON()).toEqual(firstBody);
      expect(postCount).toBe(2);
      await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => Object.keys(sessionStorage).some((key) => key.startsWith('leadshug:initial-send:v1:')))).toBe(false);
      const audit = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(conversaId)}`).then((response) => response.json()) as {
        messages: Array<{ direction: string; content: string }>;
      };
      expect(audit.messages).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(audit.messages[0]).toMatchObject({ direction: 'OUT', content: 'Snapshot persistido para retomada explícita' });
      const providerAfter = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
        headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
      }).then((response) => response.json()) as { effects: Array<{ operation: string }> };
      expect(initialSendCount(providerAfter.effects, fixture.phoneNumberId)
        - initialSendCount(providerBefore.effects, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
      expect(postCount).toBe(2);
    } finally {
      releaseResponse?.();
      if (responseReached) await responseDrained;
      await page.unroute(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`).catch(() => undefined);
    }
  });

  test('recupera um envio comum incerto pelo BFF e só libera risco após o prazo real', async ({ page, request }) => {
    test.setTimeout(150_000);
    const fixture = await seed(request, { count: 3 });
    await signIn(page, fixture);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Timeline' }).click();
    await expect(page.locator('.bolha')).toHaveCount(3);
    const providerBefore = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }>; effects: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };
    await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/send-mode`, { data: { mode: 'unknown' } }).then((response) => expect(response.status()).toBe(200));

    const body = 'Resposta comum com confirmação incerta';
    const composer = page.getByPlaceholder('Escreva uma resposta');
    await composer.fill(body);
    const messagePath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/messages`;
    const sendResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === messagePath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar', exact: true }).click();
    const sent = await sendResponse;
    expect(sent.status()).toBe(409);
    expect(await sent.json()).toMatchObject({ code: 'EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID_MISSING', outcome: 'AMBIGUOUS_SEND_RECORDED' });
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('aceitou o envio sem confirmar o ID externo');

    const auditAfterSend = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json()) as { status: string; messages: Array<{ direction: string; content: string; externalId: string | null }> };
    expect(auditAfterSend.status).toBe('QUEUED');
    expect(auditAfterSend.messages).toHaveLength(4);
    const uncertainOutbound = auditAfterSend.messages.filter((message) => message.direction === 'OUT' && message.content === body);
    expect(uncertainOutbound).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(uncertainOutbound[0]).toMatchObject({ externalId: null });
    const failedOutbound = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit-outbound?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}&content=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json());
    expect(failedOutbound).toEqual({ total: 1, accepted: 0, failed: 1, failedWithoutExternalId: 1 });
    const providerAfterSend = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as typeof providerBefore;
    expect(resourceCallCount(providerAfterSend.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId) - resourceCallCount(providerBefore.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
    expect(providerAfterSend.calls.slice(providerBefore.calls.length)
      .filter((record) => record.phoneNumberId === fixture.phoneNumberId)
      .map((record) => record.operation)).toEqual(['meta.send']);
    // This ordinary fake route records meta.send in calls, but does not add
    // provider effects. Recovery assertions below compare both snapshots to
    // prove that reconcile/acknowledge add no fixture operations.
    expect(providerAfterSend.effects).toEqual(providerBefore.effects);

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Secundário' }).click();
    const activeThreadHeading = page.locator('.inbox > .cartao.grade > .linha > strong').filter({ hasText: 'Cliente Secundário' });
    await expect(activeThreadHeading).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(activeThreadHeading).toHaveText('Cliente Secundário');
    const optionsPath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/start-options`;
    const optionsResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'GET'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === optionsPath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Cliente Timeline/ }).click();
    const options = await optionsResponse;
    expect(options.status()).toBe(200);
    const startOptions = await options.json() as { ordinaryAdmissions: Array<{ id: string; state: string; dispatchDeadlineAt: string | null }> };
    const uncertainAdmission = startOptions.ordinaryAdmissions.find((admission) => admission.state === 'UNCERTAIN');
    expect(uncertainAdmission?.id).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);
    expect(uncertainAdmission?.dispatchDeadlineAt).toBeTruthy();
    const eligibleAt = Date.parse(uncertainAdmission!.dispatchDeadlineAt!);
    expect(eligibleAt).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now());
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Recuperação do envio comum')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /Cliente Timeline sem atendente/ })).toBeVisible();

    const reconcilePath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/dispatch-admissions/${uncertainAdmission!.id}/reconcile`;
    const reconcileResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === reconcilePath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Consultar estado' }).click();
    const reconciled = await reconcileResponse;
    expect(reconciled.status()).toBe(200);
    expect(await reconciled.json()).toMatchObject({ id: uncertainAdmission!.id, state: 'UNCERTAIN', releasedAt: null });
    expect(await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json())).toEqual(providerAfterSend);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' })).toBeDisabled();
    await page.getByLabel('Confirmo o risco de mensagem duplicada.').check();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' })).toBeEnabled({ timeout: 120_000 });

    const acknowledgePath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/dispatch-admissions/${uncertainAdmission!.id}/acknowledge`;
    const acknowledgeResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === acknowledgePath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' }).click();
    const acknowledged = await acknowledgeResponse;
    expect(acknowledged.status()).toBe(200);
    expect(acknowledged.request().headers()['x-confirm-duplication-risk']).toBe('true');
    expect(await acknowledged.json()).toMatchObject({ id: uncertainAdmission!.id, acknowledged: true });
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Recuperação do envio comum')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByPlaceholder('Escreva uma resposta')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Timeline sem atendente' })).toBeVisible();

    const auditAfterRecovery = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json()) as typeof auditAfterSend;
    expect(auditAfterRecovery.status).toBe(auditAfterSend.status);
    expect(auditAfterRecovery.messages).toEqual(auditAfterSend.messages);
    expect(await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit-outbound?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}&content=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json())).toEqual(failedOutbound);
    expect(await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json())).toEqual(providerAfterSend);
  });

    expect((await ackResponse).status()).toBe(200);
    const beforeSuccessor = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };

    const successor = await successorResponse;
    expect(successor.status()).toBe(201);
    const successorBody = await successor.json() as { attempt: { id: string; state: string } };
    expect(successorBody.attempt.state).toBe('SUCCEEDED');
    expect(successorBody.attempt.id).not.toBe(outcome.attemptId);
    const afterSuccessor = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };
    expect(initialSendCount(afterSuccessor.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(2);
    const late = await page.evaluate(async (path) => {
      const response = await fetch(path, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-requested-with': 'teste' }, body: '{}' });
      return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() as { id?: string; state?: string; slotReleasedAt?: string } };
    }, ackPath.replace('/acknowledge', '/reconcile'));
    expect(late.status).toBe(200);
    expect(late.body).toMatchObject({ id: outcome.attemptId, state: 'SUCCEEDED', slotReleasedAt: expect.any(String) });
    const audit = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(conversaId)}`).then((response) => response.json()) as {
      status: string; messages: Array<{ direction: string; content: string }>;

    expect(audit.status).toBe('IN_SERVICE');
    expect(audit.messages).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(audit.messages.map((message) => message.direction)).toEqual(['OUT', 'OUT']);
    expect(audit.messages.map((message) => message.content)).toContain('sucessor após reconhecimento explícito');
    const afterLateRecovery = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };
    expect(initialSendCount(afterLateRecovery.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(2);
  });

  test('descarta prévia antiga após editar e trocar canal em ciclo A-B-A', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request, { count: 0, includeEvolution: true });
    await signIn(page, fixture);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();
    await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill('+1 (415) 555-0137');
    const openedResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
    const opened = await openedResponse;
    expect(opened.status()).toBe(201);
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial')).toBeVisible();
    let releasePreview: (() => void) | null = null;
    let reachedPreview: (() => void) | null = null;
    const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { reachedPreview = resolve; });
    const release = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releasePreview = resolve; });
    let previewRequests = 0;
    await page.route(/\/api\/bff\/conversations\/[^/]+\/initial-message-preview$/, async (route) => {
      previewRequests += 1;
      const response = await route.fetch();
      if (previewRequests === 1) {
        reachedPreview?.();
        await release;
      }
      await route.fulfill({ response });
    });
    try {
      const channelSelect = page.getByLabel('Canal selecionado');
      const channelA = await channelSelect.locator('option').nth(1).getAttribute('value');
      const channelB = await channelSelect.locator('option').nth(2).getAttribute('value');
      expect(channelA).toBeTruthy();
      expect(channelB).toBeTruthy();
      await channelSelect.selectOption(channelA!);
      await page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial').fill('prévia antiga');
      const firstPreviewResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
        && new URL(response.url()).pathname.endsWith('/initial-message-preview'));
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pré-visualizar' }).click();
      await held;
      await channelSelect.selectOption(channelB!);
      await channelSelect.selectOption(channelA!);
      await page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial').fill('prévia atual após A-B-A');
      releasePreview?.();
      await firstPreviewResponse;
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Prévia da primeira mensagem')).toHaveCount(0);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pré-visualizar' }).click();
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Prévia da primeira mensagem')).toContainText('prévia atual após A-B-A');
      expect(previewRequests).toBe(2);
      const providerState = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
        headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
      }).then((response) => response.json()) as { effects: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };
      expect(initialSendCount(providerState.effects, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(0);
    } finally {
      releasePreview?.();
      await page.unroute(/\/api\/bff\/conversations\/[^/]+\/initial-message-preview$/);
    }
  });

  test('cinco envios recebem vinte gatilhos síncronos cada sem duplicar o POST', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request, { count: 0 });
    await signIn(page, fixture);
    let heldPath = '';
    let releaseHeld: (() => void) | null = null;
    let notifyHeld: (() => void) | null = null;
    let routeHits = 0;
    let openRequests = 0;
    let activeRouteFinished: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
    let finishActiveRoute: () => void = () => undefined;
    page.on('request', (browserRequest) => {
      if (browserRequest.method() === 'POST' && new URL(browserRequest.url()).pathname
        === `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`) openRequests += 1;
    });
    await page.route(/\/api\/bff\/conversations\/[^/]+\/initial-messages$/, async (route) => {
      routeHits += 1;
      const path = new URL(route.request().url()).pathname;
      try {
        const response = await route.fetch();
        if (path === heldPath) {
          notifyHeld?.();
          await new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseHeld = resolve; });
        }
        await route.fulfill({ response });
      } finally {
        if (path === heldPath) finishActiveRoute();
      }
    });

    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt += 1) {
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();
      const phoneSuffix = String(1000 + attempt);
      await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill(`+1 (415) 555-${phoneSuffix}`);
      const openedResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
        && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`);
      const beforeOpen = openRequests;
      await page.getByRole('dialog').locator('form').evaluate((form) => {
        for (let index = 0; index < 20; index += 1) (form as HTMLFormElement).requestSubmit();
      });
      const opened = await openedResponse;
      expect(opened.status()).toBe(201);
      expect(openRequests - beforeOpen).toBe(1);
      const { conversaId } = await opened.json() as { conversaId: string };
      const providerBefore = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
        headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
      }).then((response) => response.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial')).toBeVisible();
      const channel = await page.getByLabel('Canal selecionado').locator('option').nth(1).getAttribute('value');
      expect(channel).toBeTruthy();
      await page.getByLabel('Canal selecionado').selectOption(channel!);
      await page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial').fill(`teste sincronizado ${attempt}`);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pré-visualizar' }).click();
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Prévia da primeira mensagem')).toContainText(`teste sincronizado ${attempt}`);

      heldPath = `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`;
      let signal!: () => void;
      const heldResponse = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { signal = resolve; });
      notifyHeld = signal;
      let routeReached = false;
      activeRouteFinished = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { finishActiveRoute = resolve; });
      const doneWithRoute = activeRouteFinished;
      const waitForPost = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
        && new URL(response.url()).pathname === heldPath);
      try {
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar primeiro envio' }).evaluate((node) => {
          for (let index = 0; index < 20; index += 1) (node as HTMLButtonElement).click();
        });
        await heldResponse;
        routeReached = true;
        expect(routeHits).toBe(attempt + 1);
        expect(releaseHeld).toBeTruthy();
        releaseHeld!();
        const response = await waitForPost;
        const result = response.status() === 201 ? null : await response.json().catch(() => null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
        expect(response.status(), JSON.stringify({ code: result?.code, state: result?.state, preAdmission: result?.preAdmission })).toBe(201);
        await expect(page.locator('.bolha').filter({ hasText: `teste sincronizado ${attempt}` })).toBeVisible();
        const audit = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(conversaId)}`).then((result) => result.json()) as {
          messages: Array<{ direction: string; content: string }>;
        };
        expect(audit.messages.filter((message) => message.direction === 'OUT' && message.content === `teste sincronizado ${attempt}`)).toHaveLength(1);
        const providerAfter = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
          headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
        }).then((providerResponse) => providerResponse.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };
        expect(initialSendCount(providerAfter.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId) - initialSendCount(providerBefore.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
      } finally {
        releaseHeld?.();
        if (routeReached) await doneWithRoute;
        heldPath = '';
        releaseHeld = null;
        notifyHeld = null;
      }
    }
    expect(routeHits).toBe(5);
    await page.unroute(/\/api\/bff\/conversations\/[^/]+\/initial-messages$/);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { access } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';

const hash = (value: Buffer | string) => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');

async function changedSourceFiles(directory: string, scope: RegExp, publicPaths: string[]): Promise<Array<{ path: string; status: string; sha256: string | null }>> {
  const gitArgs = ['-c', `safe.directory=${directory}`, '-C', directory];
  const parse = (output: string, layer: string) => output.trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean)
    .map((line) => { const [status, ...paths] = line.split('\t'); return { status: `${layer}:${status}`, path: paths.at(-1)! }; });
  const staged = parse(execFileSync('git', [...gitArgs, 'diff', '--cached', '--name-status', 'HEAD', '--', ...publicPaths], { encoding: 'utf8' }), 'staged');
  const unstaged = parse(execFileSync('git', [...gitArgs, 'diff', '--name-status', '--', ...publicPaths], { encoding: 'utf8' }), 'unstaged');
  const untracked = execFileSync('git', [...gitArgs, 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', ...publicPaths], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean)
    .map((path) => ({ status: '??', path }));
  const inventory = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const item of [...staged, ...unstaged, ...untracked]) if (scope.test(item.path)) {
    inventory.set(item.path, [inventory.get(item.path), item.status].filter(Boolean).join(','));
  }
  return Promise.all([...inventory.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(async ([path, status]) => {
    try { await access(resolve(directory, path)); return { path, status, sha256: hash(await readFile(resolve(directory, path))) }; }
    catch (error) {
      if (status.split(',').some((entry) => entry.endsWith(':D')) && error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error && error.code === 'ENOENT') {
        return { path, status, sha256: null };
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }));
}

export default async function timelineFreshness(): Promise<void> {
  const web = process.cwd();
  const root = resolve(web, '..');
  const api = join(root, 'api-app');
  const runtime = process.version;
  if (!/^v22\./.test(runtime)) throw new Error(`Attestation timeline exige Node 22; recebeu ${runtime}`);

  const databaseUrl = process.env.LEADSHUG_E2E_DATABASE_URL;
  if (!databaseUrl) throw new Error('LEADSHUG_E2E_DATABASE_URL ausente durante attestation.');
  const db = new URL(databaseUrl);
  const database = decodeURIComponent(db.pathname.slice(1));
  if (!database.startsWith('leadshug_timeline_')) throw new Error(`Banco fora da família descartável: ${database}`);

  const apiPort = process.env.LEADSHUG_API_PORT ?? '3100';
  const apiEndpoint = `http://127.0.0.1:${apiPort}`;
  const [apiHealth, fixtureHealth, htmlResponse] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(`${apiEndpoint}/health`),
    fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3101/health'),
    fetch('http://127.0.0.1:4173/'),
  ]);
  for (const [label, response] of [['API', apiHealth], ['fixtures', fixtureHealth], ['preview', htmlResponse]] as const) {
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`${label} indisponível na attestation: HTTP ${response.status}`);
  }
  const html = await htmlResponse.text();
  const asset = html.match(/src="([^"]+\.js)"/);
  if (!asset) throw new Error('HTML servido não referencia o bundle JavaScript esperado.');
  const jsResponse = await fetch(new URL(asset[1], 'http://127.0.0.1:4173'));
  if (!jsResponse.ok) throw new Error(`Bundle servido retornou HTTP ${jsResponse.status}`);
  const servedJs = Buffer.from(await jsResponse.arrayBuffer());
  const servedPath = resolve(web, 'dist', `.${new URL(asset[1], 'http://127.0.0.1').pathname}`);
  const distJs = await readFile(servedPath);
  if (hash(servedJs) !== hash(distJs)) throw new Error('Bundle servido não corresponde ao artefato em web-app/dist.');

  const gitArgs = (directory: string, ...args: string[]) => ['-c', `safe.directory=${directory}`, '-C', directory, ...args];
  const git = (directory: string, ...args: string[]) => execFileSync('git', gitArgs(directory, ...args), { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
  const diffHash = (directory: string, publicPaths: string[]) => hash(execFileSync('git', gitArgs(
    directory, 'diff', '--no-ext-diff', '--binary', 'HEAD', '--', ...publicPaths,
  )));
  const apiPublicPaths = [
    'src', 'test', 'prisma', 'e2e', 'public', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json',
    'Dockerfile', '.dockerignore', '.env.example', '.gitignore', 'eslint.config.mjs',
    'nest-cli.json', 'railway.json', 'tsconfig.json', 'tsconfig.build.json',
    'vitest.config.ts', 'vitest.config.e2e.ts', 'vitest.config.cov.ts', 'docker',
  ];
  const webPublicPaths = [
    'src', 'e2e', 'public', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'index.html',
    'Dockerfile', '.dockerignore', '.gitignore', 'eslint.config.js', 'playwright.config.ts',
    'railway.json', 'tsconfig.json', 'vite.config.ts', 'docker', 'nginx',
  ];
  const apiSourceManifest = await changedSourceFiles(api, /^(src\/|prisma\/|test\/|package(?:-lock)?\.json$|Dockerfile$|\.dockerignore$|\.env\.example$|nest-cli\.json$|tsconfig(?:\.[^/]+)?\.json$)/,
    ['src', 'prisma', 'test', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'Dockerfile', '.dockerignore', '.env.example', 'nest-cli.json', 'tsconfig.json', 'tsconfig.build.json']);
  const webSourceManifest = await changedSourceFiles(web, /^(src\/|e2e\/|playwright\.config\.ts$|vite\.config\.ts$|Dockerfile$|\.dockerignore$|package(?:-lock)?\.json$|tsconfig(?:\.[^/]+)?\.json$)/,
    ['src', 'e2e', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'Dockerfile', '.dockerignore', 'playwright.config.ts', 'vite.config.ts', 'tsconfig.json', 'tsconfig.app.json', 'tsconfig.node.json']);
  const requireFromApi = createRequire(join(api, 'package.json'));
  const { PrismaClient } = requireFromApi('@prisma/client') as { PrismaClient: new (options: { datasources: { db: { url: string } } }) => any };
  const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl } } });
  let completedMigrations: number;
  try {
    const rows = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe('SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM "_prisma_migrations" WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL') as Array<{ count: number }>;
    completedMigrations = Number(rows[0]?.count ?? 0);
  } finally {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  }

  const artifactDirectory = resolve(root, 'foundation_documentation/artifacts/tmp/inbox-timeline-execution');
  await mkdir(artifactDirectory, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(join(artifactDirectory, 'served-index-authority.html'), html);
  await writeFile(join(artifactDirectory, 'served-app-authority.js'), servedJs);
  const runId = process.env.LEADSHUG_ATTESTATION_RUN_ID ?? new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(runId)) throw new Error('LEADSHUG_ATTESTATION_RUN_ID contém caracteres inválidos.');
  const attestation = {
    capturedAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
    runId,
    branch: {
      api: { name: git(api, 'branch', '--show-current'), head: git(api, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), declaredBaseline: 'ae6a9662c29b77276351aa9de653a47276372246', diffSha256: diffHash(api, apiPublicPaths), sourceManifest: apiSourceManifest },
      web: { name: git(web, 'branch', '--show-current'), head: git(web, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), declaredBaseline: '4e56f6c1f4515b918d05b8c87e890d42e8542c56', diffSha256: diffHash(web, webPublicPaths), sourceManifest: webSourceManifest },
    },
    runtime,
    database: { name: database, endpoint: `${db.protocol}//${db.hostname}:${db.port || '5432'}/${database}`, completedMigrations },
    endpoints: { apiHealth: apiHealth.status, fixtureHealth: fixtureHealth.status, preview: htmlResponse.status, servedBundle: new URL(asset[1], 'http://127.0.0.1:4173').pathname },
    servedBundleSha256: hash(servedJs),
    distBundleSha256: hash(distJs),
    operationalDataBoundary: 'API .local-files payloads and private dotenv files are excluded from public-source inventories and binary diff pathspecs; an omitted file is not reported as a source deletion.',
  };
  const serialized = `${JSON.stringify(attestation, null, 2)}\n`;
  await writeFile(join(artifactDirectory, `attestation-browser-${runId}.json`), serialized);
  await writeFile(join(artifactDirectory, 'attestation-browser-authority.json'), serialized);
}
```

```typescript
import { ConflictException, ForbiddenException, Inject, Injectable, NotFoundException, ServiceUnavailableException, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, type MessageTemplateDraft } from '@prisma/client';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { AccessService } from '../access/access.service';
import { atLeast, type Role } from '../access/role';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT_RESOLVER, type TemplateDefinition, type TemplateManagementContext, type TemplateManagementResolver, type TemplateReference, type TemplateSummary } from './template-management.ports';
import { templateDefinitionSemanticFingerprint } from './template-definition';
import { TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY, type TemplateTransactionBoundary } from './template-transaction-boundary';

export const TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_CLOCK = Symbol('TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_CLOCK');
export interface TemplateObservationClock { now(): Date }
const LEASE_MS = 60_000;
const DEBOUNCE_MS = 10_000;
const FRESH_MS = 300_000;

class ObservationCommitUnconfirmedError extends Error {}
type ObservationAuthRevalidation = (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<void>;

interface ProjectedSavedObservation {
  remoteTemplateId: string;
  status: string;
  name: string | null;
  language: string | null;
  category: string;
  parameterFormat: string;
  components: Prisma.JsonValue;
  supported: boolean;
  semanticFingerprint: string | null;
  available: boolean;
  safeCode: string | undefined;
  observedAt: Date;
  observedFence: string;
  eligible: boolean;
}

export interface TemplateObservationBinding {
  readonly mantenedoraId: string;
  readonly buId: string;
  readonly channelId: string;
  readonly providerResourceIdentityId: string;
  readonly accountReference: string;
  readonly generation: number;
  readonly pairingEpoch: number;
  readonly activeCredentialVersion: number | null;
}

@Injectable()
export class TemplateObservationService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly access: AccessService,
    @Inject(TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT_RESOLVER) private readonly resolver: TemplateManagementResolver,
    @Inject(TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY) private readonly transactions: TemplateTransactionBoundary,
    @Inject(TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_CLOCK) private readonly clock: TemplateObservationClock,
  ) {}

  async refreshDraft(actorId: string, draftId: string, revalidateAuth?: ObservationAuthRevalidation) {
    const { draft } = await this.authorizeDraft(actorId, draftId);
    const reference = await this.currentReference(actorId, draft.buId, draft.channelId);
    const resolved = await this.resolver.resolve(reference);
    this.assertBinding(draft, resolved.context);
    const operation = await this.prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findFirst({
      where: { draftId, buId: draft.buId, mantenedoraId: draft.mantenedoraId },
      orderBy: [{ revision: 'desc' }], select: { remoteTemplateId: true, acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId: true, phase: true },
    });
    if (!operation?.remoteTemplateId || !['ACCEPTED', 'AMBIGUOUS'].includes(operation.phase)) {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_REMOTE_ID_UNAVAILABLE' });
    }
    const lease = await this.acquire(resolved.context);
    if (!lease.acquired) return { phase: 'REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS', retryAfter: 10 };
    try {
      const summary = await resolved.provider.getTemplate({ context: resolved.context, remoteTemplateId: operation.remoteTemplateId });
      const applied = await this.applyObservation(actorId, resolved.context, lease, summary, draftId, revalidateAuth);
      if (!applied) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED' });
      const projected = await this.projectObservation(resolved.context, summary.remoteTemplateId, draft.definition);
      if (operation.acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId && operation.acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId !== operation.remoteTemplateId) {
        return { ...projected, eligible: false, eligibleForUse: false, safeCode: 'PROVIDER_ACK_CONFLICT' };
      }
      return projected;
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.isAuthOrAccessFailure(error)) { await this.releaseLeaseAfterAuthorizationFailure(lease); throw error; }
      if (error instanceof ConflictException && error.getResponse() && (error.getResponse() as { code?: string }).code === 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED') throw error;
      if (error instanceof ObservationCommitUnconfirmedError) throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE' });
      if (!await this.markUnavailableSafely(actorId, resolved.context, lease, operation.remoteTemplateId, null, 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_UNAVAILABLE', undefined, revalidateAuth, draftId)) {
        throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED' });
      }
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_UNAVAILABLE' });
    }
  }

  async refreshCatalog(actorId: string, buId: string, channelId: string, after: string | null, revalidateAuth?: ObservationAuthRevalidation) {
    await this.authorizeBu(actorId, buId);
    const currentReference = await this.currentReference(actorId, buId, channelId);
    const resolved = await this.resolver.resolve(currentReference);
    const lease = await this.acquire(resolved.context);
    if (!lease.acquired) return { phase: 'REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS', retryAfter: 10 };
    const cursorHash = this.hash(after ?? 'first-page');
    try {
      const page = await resolved.provider.listTemplates({ context: resolved.context, after, limit: 50 });
      const applied = await this.applyCatalogPage(actorId, resolved.context, lease, cursorHash, after, page.templates, page.nextCursor, revalidateAuth);
      if (!applied) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED' });
      return this.getCatalog(actorId, buId, channelId, after);
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.isAuthOrAccessFailure(error)) throw error;
      if (error instanceof ConflictException && error.getResponse() && (error.getResponse() as { code?: string }).code === 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED') throw error;
      if (error instanceof ObservationCommitUnconfirmedError) throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE' });
      if (!await this.markUnavailableSafely(actorId, resolved.context, lease, null, cursorHash, 'TEMPLATE_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE', after, revalidateAuth)) {
        throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED' });
      }
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE' });
    }
  }

  async getCatalog(actorId: string, buId: string, channelId: string, after: string | null) {
    await this.authorizeBu(actorId, buId);
    const currentReference = await this.currentReference(actorId, buId, channelId);
    const resolved = await this.resolver.resolve(currentReference);
    const cursorHash = this.hash(after ?? 'first-page');
    const page = await this.prisma.messageTemplateCatalogPage.findUnique({ where: { contextKey_cursorHash: { contextKey: this.contextKey(resolved.context), cursorHash } } });
    if (!page) return { items: [], nextCursor: null, available: false, safeCode: 'TEMPLATE_CATALOG_NOT_OBSERVED', observedAt: null };
    const ids = Array.isArray(page.remoteTemplateIds) ? page.remoteTemplateIds.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string') : [];
    if (ids.length > 50) return { items: [], nextCursor: null, available: false,
      safeCode: 'TEMPLATE_CATALOG_INVALID', observedAt: page.observedAt };
    const rows = ids.length ? await this.prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{
      remoteTemplateId: string; status: string; name: string | null; language: string | null; category: string;
      parameterFormat: string; components: Prisma.JsonValue; supported: boolean; semanticFingerprint: string | null;
      available: boolean; safeCode: string | null; observedEligible: boolean; observedAt: Date; observedFence: bigint;
    }>>(Prisma.sql`
      WITH requested AS (
        SELECT remote_template_id, ordinality
        FROM unnest(ARRAY[${Prisma.join(ids)}]::varchar(128)[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS request(remote_template_id, ordinality)
      )
      SELECT observation.remote_template_id AS "remoteTemplateId", observation.status, observation.name, observation.language, observation.category,
        observation.parameter_format AS "parameterFormat", observation.components, observation.supported,
        observation.semantic_fingerprint AS "semanticFingerprint", observation.available, observation.safe_code AS "safeCode",
        observation.observed_eligible AS "observedEligible", observation.observed_at AS "observedAt", observation.observed_fence AS "observedFence"
      FROM requested
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT remote_template_id, status, name, language, category, parameter_format, components, supported,
          semantic_fingerprint, available, safe_code, observed_eligible, observed_at, observed_fence
        FROM message_template_remote_observations
        WHERE context_key = ${page.contextKey}::char(64)
          AND remote_template_id = requested.remote_template_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) observation
      ORDER BY requested.ordinality`) : [];
    const byId = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.remoteTemplateId, row]));
    const fresh = this.clock.now().getTime() - page.observedAt.getTime() <= FRESH_MS;
    return { items: ids.flatMap((id) => { const row = byId.get(id); return row ? [this.projectRow(row)] : []; }),
      nextCursor: page.nextCursor, available: page.available && fresh, safeCode: page.safeCode ?? (!fresh ? 'TEMPLATE_CATALOG_STALE' : undefined), observedAt: page.observedAt };
  }

  async projectSavedObservation(binding: TemplateObservationBinding, remoteTemplateId: string,
    definitionValue: unknown, acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId?: string | null): Promise<(ProjectedSavedObservation & { matchesDefinition: boolean; eligibleForUse: boolean }) | null> {
    const historicalContextKey = this.hash({ mantenedoraId: binding.mantenedoraId, buId: binding.buId,
      channelId: binding.channelId, accountReference: binding.accountReference,
      generation: binding.generation, pairingEpoch: binding.pairingEpoch,
      providerResourceIdentityId: binding.providerResourceIdentityId,
      activeCredentialVersion: binding.activeCredentialVersion });
    let currentContext: TemplateManagementContext | null = null;
    try {
      const channel = await this.prisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { id: binding.channelId, buId: binding.buId }, select: { generation: true } });
      if (channel) {
        const resolved = await this.resolver.resolve({ buId: binding.buId, channelId: binding.channelId, expectedGeneration: channel.generation });
        const sameResourceAssociation = resolved.context.mantenedoraId === binding.mantenedoraId
          && resolved.context.buId === binding.buId && resolved.context.channelId === binding.channelId
          && resolved.context.providerResourceIdentityId === binding.providerResourceIdentityId
          && resolved.context.accountReference === binding.accountReference;
        if (sameResourceAssociation) currentContext = resolved.context;
      }
    } catch { /* historical detail remains readable, but a stale binding cannot be eligible */ }

    const currentContextKey = currentContext ? this.contextKey(currentContext) : null;
    const currentRow = currentContextKey ? await this.prisma.messageTemplateRemoteObservation.findUnique({
      where: { contextKey_remoteTemplateId: { contextKey: currentContextKey, remoteTemplateId } },
    }) : null;
    const row = currentRow ?? (currentContextKey === historicalContextKey ? null
      : await this.prisma.messageTemplateRemoteObservation.findUnique({
        where: { contextKey_remoteTemplateId: { contextKey: historicalContextKey, remoteTemplateId } },
      }));
    if (!row) return null;
    const currentObservation = currentRow !== null;

    let matchesDefinition = false;
    try { matchesDefinition = row.semanticFingerprint !== null
      && row.semanticFingerprint === this.definitionFingerprint(definitionValue as TemplateDefinition); }
    catch { /* unsupported historical definitions cannot be considered a match */ }
    const projected = this.projectRow(row);
    const available = currentObservation && projected.available;
    const ackMatchesAssociation = !acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId || acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId === remoteTemplateId;
    const eligible = available && matchesDefinition && ackMatchesAssociation && row.supported && row.status === 'APPROVED';
    return { ...projected, available, eligible,
      ...(!currentObservation ? { safeCode: 'TEMPLATE_CONTEXT_STALE' }
        : !ackMatchesAssociation ? { safeCode: 'PROVIDER_ACK_CONFLICT' } : {}),
      matchesDefinition, eligibleForUse: eligible };
  }

  private async acquire(context: TemplateManagementContext): Promise<{ acquired: boolean; ownerId: string; fence: bigint; contextKey: string }> {
    const contextKey = this.contextKey(context);
    const ownerId = randomUUID();
    try { return await this.transactions.run('observation', async (tx) => {
      const now = this.clock.now();
      await tx.messageTemplateObservationLease.createMany({ data: [{
        contextKey, mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId, buId: context.buId,
        channelId: context.channelId, accountReference: context.accountReference,
        channelGeneration: context.generation, pairingEpoch: context.pairingEpoch,
        providerResourceIdentityId: context.providerResourceIdentityId,
        activeCredentialVersion: context.activeCredentialVersion ?? 0, fence: 0n,
      }], skipDuplicates: true });
      const current = await tx.messageTemplateObservationLease.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { contextKey } });
      const debounceDone = !current.lastStartedAt || current.lastStartedAt.getTime() <= now.getTime() - DEBOUNCE_MS;
      const updated = debounceDone ? await tx.messageTemplateObservationLease.updateMany({
        where: { contextKey, lastStartedAt: current.lastStartedAt, OR: [{ leaseUntil: null }, { leaseUntil: { lte: now } }] },
        data: { ownerId, fence: { increment: 1n }, leaseUntil: new Date(now.getTime() + LEASE_MS), lastStartedAt: now },
      }) : { count: 0 };
      const latest = await tx.messageTemplateObservationLease.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { contextKey } });
      return { acquired: updated.count === 1, ownerId, fence: latest.fence, contextKey };
    }); } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ConflictException) throw error;
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE' });
    }
  }

  private async applyObservation(actorId: string, context: TemplateManagementContext, lease: { ownerId: string; fence: bigint; contextKey: string }, summary: TemplateSummary, draftId: string, revalidateAuth?: ObservationAuthRevalidation): Promise<boolean> {
    const observedAt = this.clock.now();
    try {
      return await this.transactions.run('observation', async (tx) => {
        await revalidateAuth?.(tx);
        await this.assertTxObservationAccess(tx, actorId, context, draftId);
        if (!await this.ownsLease(tx, actorId, context, lease, observedAt)) return false;
        await this.writeObservation(tx, lease, observedAt, summary);
        await this.releaseLease(tx, lease);
        return true;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.isAuthOrAccessFailure(error)) throw error;
      try { if (await this.observationCommitted(lease, observedAt, summary)) return true; }
      catch { throw new ObservationCommitUnconfirmedError(); }
      throw new ObservationCommitUnconfirmedError();
    }
  }

  private async applyCatalogPage(actorId: string, context: TemplateManagementContext, lease: { ownerId: string; fence: bigint; contextKey: string }, cursorHash: string, after: string | null, summaries: readonly TemplateSummary[], nextCursor: string | null, revalidateAuth?: ObservationAuthRevalidation): Promise<boolean> {

        supported: summary.supported, available: true, safeCode: null, observedEligible, observedAt, observedFence: lease.fence },

  private async catalogPageCommitted(lease: { fence: bigint; contextKey: string }, cursorHash: string, observedAt: Date, summaries: readonly TemplateSummary[], nextCursor: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
    const currentLease = await this.prisma.messageTemplateObservationLease.findUnique({ where: { contextKey: lease.contextKey }, select: { fence: true, ownerId: true, leaseUntil: true } });
    if (currentLease?.fence !== lease.fence || currentLease.ownerId !== null || currentLease.leaseUntil !== null) return false;

      where: { contextKey: lease.contextKey, remoteTemplateId: { in: ids as string[] }, observedFence: lease.fence, observedAt, available: true },

  private async markUnavailable(actorId: string, context: TemplateManagementContext, lease: { ownerId: string; fence: bigint; contextKey: string }, remoteId: string | null, cursorHash: string | null, safeCode: string, requestedCursor: string | null = null, revalidateAuth?: ObservationAuthRevalidation, draftId?: string): Promise<boolean> {

  private async markUnavailableSafely(actorId: string, context: TemplateManagementContext,
    lease: { ownerId: string; fence: bigint; contextKey: string }, remoteId: string | null,
    cursorHash: string | null, safeCode: string, requestedCursor: string | null = null,

    const currentLease = await this.prisma.messageTemplateObservationLease.findUnique({ where: { contextKey: lease.contextKey }, select: { fence: true, ownerId: true, leaseUntil: true } });

      && row.supported === summary.supported

  private async ownsLease(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actorId: string, context: TemplateManagementContext, lease: { ownerId: string; fence: bigint; contextKey: string }, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
    const lock = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ contextKey: string }>>`SELECT context_key AS "contextKey" FROM message_template_observation_leases WHERE context_key = ${lease.contextKey} FOR UPDATE`;
    if (lock.length !== 1) return false;
    const current = await tx.messageTemplateObservationLease.findFirst({ where: {
      contextKey: lease.contextKey, ownerId: lease.ownerId, fence: lease.fence, leaseUntil: { gt: now },
      mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId, buId: context.buId, channelId: context.channelId, accountReference: context.accountReference,
      channelGeneration: context.generation, pairingEpoch: context.pairingEpoch,
      providerResourceIdentityId: context.providerResourceIdentityId, activeCredentialVersion: context.activeCredentialVersion ?? 0,
    }, select: { contextKey: true } });
    if (!current) return false;
    // Pin all mutable inputs while resolver rechecks the same transaction snapshot.
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM app_users WHERE id = ${actorId} FOR UPDATE`;
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM business_units WHERE id = ${context.buId} AND mantenedora_id = ${context.mantenedoraId} FOR UPDATE`;
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT user_id FROM user_bu_roles WHERE user_id = ${actorId} AND bu_id = ${context.buId} FOR UPDATE`;
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM bu_channels WHERE id = ${context.channelId} AND bu_id = ${context.buId} FOR UPDATE`;
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM provider_resource_identities WHERE id = ${context.providerResourceIdentityId} AND current_channel_id = ${context.channelId} FOR UPDATE`;
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT channel_id FROM channel_credentials WHERE channel_id = ${context.channelId} FOR UPDATE`;
    const checkedAt = this.clock.now();
    const stillOwned = await tx.messageTemplateObservationLease.findFirst({ where: {
      contextKey: lease.contextKey, ownerId: lease.ownerId, fence: lease.fence, leaseUntil: { gt: checkedAt },
    }, select: { contextKey: true } });
    if (!stillOwned) return false;
    const [actor, bu, grant] = await Promise.all([
      tx.appUser.findFirst({ where: { id: actorId, mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId, status: 'ATIVO' }, select: { id: true } }),
      tx.businessUnit.findFirst({ where: { id: context.buId, mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId, status: 'ATIVO' }, select: { id: true } }),
      tx.userBuRole.findUnique({ where: { userId_buId: { userId: actorId, buId: context.buId } }, select: { userId: true } }),
    ]);
    if (!actor || !bu || !grant) return false;
    try {
      const actual = await this.resolver.resolve({ buId: context.buId, channelId: context.channelId, expectedGeneration: context.generation }, { transaction: tx });
      return this.sameContext(context, actual.context);
    } catch { return false; }

  private async releaseLease(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, lease: { ownerId: string; fence: bigint; contextKey: string }): Promise<void> {
    const checkedAt = this.clock.now();
    const released = await tx.messageTemplateObservationLease.updateMany({ where: { contextKey: lease.contextKey, ownerId: lease.ownerId, fence: lease.fence, leaseUntil: { gt: checkedAt } }, data: { ownerId: null, leaseUntil: null } });
    if (released.count !== 1) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED' });
  }

  private async projectObservation(context: TemplateManagementContext, remoteId: string, definitionValue: Prisma.JsonValue) {
    const row = await this.prisma.messageTemplateRemoteObservation.findUnique({ where: { contextKey_remoteTemplateId: { contextKey: this.contextKey(context), remoteTemplateId: remoteId } } });
    if (!row) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_UNAVAILABLE' });
    const definition = definitionValue as unknown as TemplateDefinition;
    const current = row.semanticFingerprint !== null && row.semanticFingerprint === this.definitionFingerprint(definition);
    return { ...this.projectRow(row), matchesDefinition: current,
      eligibleForUse: current && row.available && row.supported && row.status === 'APPROVED'
        && this.clock.now().getTime() - row.observedAt.getTime() <= FRESH_MS };

  private projectRow(row: { remoteTemplateId: string; status: string; name: string | null; language: string | null; category: string; parameterFormat: string; components: Prisma.JsonValue; supported: boolean; semanticFingerprint: string | null; available: boolean; safeCode: string | null; observedEligible: boolean; observedAt: Date; observedFence: bigint }): ProjectedSavedObservation {
    const current = this.clock.now().getTime() - row.observedAt.getTime() <= FRESH_MS;
    return { remoteTemplateId: row.remoteTemplateId, status: row.status, name: row.name, language: row.language,
      category: row.category, parameterFormat: row.parameterFormat, components: row.components,
      supported: row.supported, semanticFingerprint: row.semanticFingerprint,
      available: row.available && current, safeCode: row.safeCode ?? undefined,
      observedAt: row.observedAt, observedFence: row.observedFence.toString(),
      eligible: row.available && current && row.observedEligible && row.supported && row.status === 'APPROVED' };

  private async authorizeDraft(actorId: string, draftId: string) {
    const actor = await this.prisma.appUser.findUnique({ where: { id: actorId }, select: { mantenedoraId: true, status: true } });
    if (!actor || actor.status !== 'ATIVO') throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND' });
    const grants = await this.access.grantsDoUsuario(actorId);
    const draft = await this.prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findFirst({ where: { id: draftId, mantenedoraId: actor.mantenedoraId, buId: { in: grants.map((grant) => grant.buId) } } });
    const grant = draft && grants.find((row) => row.buId === draft.buId);
    if (!draft || !grant || (draft.creatorUserId !== actorId && !atLeast(grant.role, 'ADMIN'))) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND' });
    return { draft, role: grant.role as Role };
  }

  private async assertTxObservationAccess(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actorId: string,
    context: TemplateManagementContext, draftId?: string): Promise<void> {
    const [actor, bu, grants] = await Promise.all([
      tx.appUser.findFirst({ where: { id: actorId, mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId, status: 'ATIVO' }, select: { id: true } }),
      tx.businessUnit.findFirst({ where: { id: context.buId, mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId, status: 'ATIVO' }, select: { id: true } }),
      tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ role: Role }>>`SELECT role::text AS role FROM user_bu_roles
        WHERE user_id = ${actorId} AND bu_id = ${context.buId} FOR SHARE`,
    ]);
    if (!actor) throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'NAO_AUTENTICADO' });
    if (!bu) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND' });
    const role = grants[0]?.role;
    if (!role) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_AUTHORIZATION_CHANGED' });
    if (draftId) {
      const draft = await tx.messageTemplateDraft.findFirst({ where: {
        id: draftId, buId: context.buId, mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId,
        channelId: context.channelId, providerResourceIdentityId: context.providerResourceIdentityId,
        accountReference: context.accountReference,
      }, select: { creatorUserId: true } });
      if (!draft) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND' });
      if (draft.creatorUserId !== actorId && !atLeast(role, 'ADMIN')) {
        throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_AUTHORIZATION_CHANGED' });
      }
    } else if (!atLeast(role, 'ATENDENTE')) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_AUTHORIZATION_CHANGED' });
    }
  }

  private isAuthOrAccessFailure(error: unknown): boolean {
    return error instanceof UnauthorizedException || error instanceof ForbiddenException || error instanceof NotFoundException;
  }

  private async authorizeBu(actorId: string, buId: string): Promise<void> {
    const scoped = await this.access.resolverBu(actorId, buId);
    const actor = await this.prisma.appUser.findUnique({ where: { id: actorId }, select: { mantenedoraId: true, status: true } });
    const bu = await this.prisma.businessUnit.findUnique({ where: { id: buId }, select: { mantenedoraId: true, status: true } });
    if (!scoped || !actor || actor.status !== 'ATIVO' || !bu || bu.status !== 'ATIVO' || actor.mantenedoraId !== bu.mantenedoraId) {
      throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND' });
    }
  }

  private assertBinding(draft: MessageTemplateDraft, context: TemplateManagementContext): void {
    if (draft.mantenedoraId !== context.mantenedoraId || draft.channelId !== context.channelId || draft.providerResourceIdentityId !== context.providerResourceIdentityId) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_CHANNEL_CONTEXT_STALE' });
    if (draft.accountReference !== context.accountReference) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'CONTA_ALTERADA' });
  }

  private sameContext(a: TemplateManagementContext, b: TemplateManagementContext): boolean {
    return a.mantenedoraId === b.mantenedoraId && a.buId === b.buId && a.channelId === b.channelId && a.accountReference === b.accountReference
      && a.providerResourceIdentityId === b.providerResourceIdentityId && a.generation === b.generation
      && a.pairingEpoch === b.pairingEpoch && a.activeCredentialVersion === b.activeCredentialVersion;
  }

  private async currentReference(actorId: string, buId: string, channelId: string): Promise<TemplateReference> {
    await this.authorizeBu(actorId, buId);
    const channel = await this.prisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { id: channelId, buId }, select: { generation: true } });
    if (!channel) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND' });
    return { buId, channelId, expectedGeneration: channel.generation };
  }
  private contextKey(context: TemplateManagementContext): string { return this.hash({ mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId, buId: context.buId, channelId: context.channelId, accountReference: context.accountReference, generation: context.generation, pairingEpoch: context.pairingEpoch, providerResourceIdentityId: context.providerResourceIdentityId, activeCredentialVersion: context.activeCredentialVersion }); }
  private hash(value: unknown): string { return createHash('sha256').update(this.canonicalJson(value)).digest('hex'); }
  private canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map((item) => this.canonicalJson(item)).join(',')}]`;
    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
      const row = value as Record<string, unknown>;
      return `{${Object.keys(row).filter((key) => key !== 'example').sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${this.canonicalJson(row[key])}`).join(',')}}`;
    }
    return JSON.stringify(value) ?? 'null';
  }
  private definitionFingerprint(definition: TemplateDefinition): string {
    return templateDefinitionSemanticFingerprint(definition);
  }
}
```
